description.en: The ridge just in front of the central sulcus, running from the top of the hemisphere down to the lateral fissure. It is the primary motor cortex (Brodmann area 4): its large pyramidal (Betz) cells send axons down the corticospinal tract to the spinal cord.
description.uz: Markaziy egat oldidagi, yarim shar tepasidan lateral egatgacha cho'zilgan burma. Bu birlamchi harakat po'stlog'i (Brodmann 4-maydon): uning yirik piramidal (Betz) hujayralari aksonlarini kortikospinal trakt orqali orqa miyaga yuboradi.

role.en: Starts voluntary movement. The body is mapped upside-down along it (the motor homunculus): leg at the top near the midline, hand and face lower down on the lateral side.
role.uz: Ixtiyoriy harakatni boshlaydi. Tana unda teskari tartibda joylashgan (harakat gomunkulusi): oyoq yuqorida, o'rta chiziq yaqinida; qo'l va yuz pastroqda, lateral tomonda.

clinical.en: A stroke here causes weakness on the opposite side of the body (contralateral hemiparesis); the leg or the face is affected depending on which part is hit (ACA vs MCA territory).
clinical.uz: Bu yerdagi insult tananing qarama-qarshi tomonida kuchsizlik (kontralateral gemiparez) beradi; qaysi qism zararlanganiga qarab oyoq yoki yuz ko'proq ta'sirlanadi (ACA yoki MCA hovuzi).

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience 2nd ed. — Primary motor cortex (NCBI Bookshelf)

description.en: The ridge immediately behind the central sulcus. It is the primary somatosensory cortex (Brodmann areas 3, 1 and 2), where touch, pressure, vibration and position sense from the opposite side of the body first reach the cortex.
description.uz: Markaziy egatning bevosita orqasidagi burma. Bu birlamchi somatosensor po'stloq (Brodmann 3, 1, 2-maydonlar) — tananing qarama-qarshi tomonidan keladigan sezish, bosim, tebranish va holat sezgisi po'stloqqa avval shu yerga yetib keladi.

role.en: Conscious perception of body sensation, with a sensory homunculus that gives the fingers, lips and tongue a disproportionately large area.
role.uz: Tana sezgisining ongli idroki; sensor gomunkulusda barmoqlar, lablar va til nomutanosib katta joy egallaydi.

clinical.en: Damage produces loss of fine discriminative touch and position sense on the opposite side (cortical sensory loss), not complete anaesthesia.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi tomonda nozik farqlovchi sezgi va holat sezgisining yo'qolishini beradi (kortikal sensor yetishmovchilik), to'liq anesteziya emas.

description.en: The uppermost of the three frontal gyri, running from the frontal pole back to the precentral gyrus along the top of the hemisphere and onto its medial surface.
description.uz: Uchta peshona burmasining eng yuqorisi; peshona qutbidan orqaga, precentral burmagacha yarim shar tepasi va medial yuzasi bo'ylab cho'zilgan.

role.en: Its posterior part houses the supplementary motor area (planning and sequencing of movement); the anterior part is prefrontal cortex involved in working memory, attention and self-awareness.
role.uz: Orqa qismida qo'shimcha harakat maydoni (harakatni rejalashtirish va ketma-ketligi) joylashgan; oldingi qismi ishchi xotira, diqqat va o'z-o'zini anglashda qatnashadigan prefrontal po'stloq.

clinical.en: Medial lesions (often ACA infarcts or tumours) can cause apathy, difficulty starting movements and, bilaterally, urinary incontinence.
clinical.uz: Medial zararlanishlar (ko'pincha ACA infarkti yoki o'smalar) apatiya, harakatni boshlashda qiyinchilik va ikki tomonlama bo'lsa — siydik tuta olmaslik berishi mumkin.

description.en: The middle of the three frontal gyri, between the superior and inferior frontal sulci. Its posterior end contains the frontal eye field; the rest is dorsolateral prefrontal cortex.
description.uz: Uchta peshona burmasining o'rtadagisi, yuqori va pastki peshona egatlari orasida. Orqa uchida peshona ko'z maydoni, qolgani dorsolateral prefrontal po'stloq.

role.en: Voluntary eye movements toward the opposite side, working memory, planning and cognitive flexibility.
role.uz: Ko'zlarning qarama-qarshi tomonga ixtiyoriy harakati, ishchi xotira, rejalashtirish va kognitiv moslashuvchanlik.

clinical.en: A frontal eye field lesion makes the eyes deviate toward the side of the lesion (the patient 'looks at' the lesion); dorsolateral damage impairs executive function.
clinical.uz: Peshona ko'z maydoni zararlansa ko'zlar zararlangan tomonga og'adi (bemor 'o'choqqa qaraydi'); dorsolateral zararlanish ijro funksiyalarini buzadi.

description.en: The lowest frontal gyrus, divided into orbital, triangular and opercular parts. In the dominant (usually left) hemisphere the triangular and opercular parts (Brodmann areas 45 and 44) form Broca's area.
description.uz: Eng pastki peshona burmasi; orbital, uchburchak va operkulyar qismlarga bo'linadi. Dominant (odatda chap) yarim sharda uchburchak va operkulyar qismlar (Brodmann 45 va 44) Broka maydonini tashkil qiladi.

role.en: Speech production, grammar and the motor planning of articulation; the right side contributes to prosody and response inhibition.
role.uz: Nutq hosil qilish, grammatika va artikulyatsiyani harakat jihatidan rejalashtirish; o'ng tomon intonatsiya va javobni tormozlashda qatnashadi.

clinical.en: Broca's (expressive, non-fluent) aphasia: the patient understands but speaks slowly with effort and few words, often with right facial and arm weakness because the motor cortex is next door.
clinical.uz: Broka (ekspressiv, noravon) afaziyasi: bemor tushunadi, lekin sekin, zo'riqib, kam so'z bilan gapiradi; harakat po'stlog'i yonida bo'lgani uchun ko'pincha o'ng yuz va qo'l kuchsizligi qo'shiladi.

description.en: The top gyrus of the temporal lobe, just below the lateral fissure. On its hidden upper surface lie Heschl's gyri (primary auditory cortex, areas 41/42); its posterior part in the dominant hemisphere is Wernicke's area (area 22).
description.uz: Chakka bo'lagining eng yuqori burmasi, lateral egat ostida. Yashirin yuqori yuzasida Heshl burmalari (birlamchi eshitish po'stlog'i, 41/42) joylashgan; dominant yarim sharda orqa qismi Vernike maydoni (22).

role.en: Hearing and, in the dominant hemisphere, understanding spoken language; also processes voices and social cues.
role.uz: Eshitish va dominant yarim sharda og'zaki nutqni tushunish; ovozlar va ijtimoiy signallarni ham qayta ishlaydi.

clinical.en: Wernicke's (receptive, fluent) aphasia: fluent but meaningless speech with poor comprehension, typically from an inferior-division MCA stroke.
clinical.uz: Vernike (retseptiv, ravon) afaziyasi: ravon, lekin ma'nosiz nutq va tushunishning buzilishi; odatda MCA pastki bo'limi insultidan.

description.en: The temporal gyrus between the superior and inferior temporal sulci on the lateral surface of the temporal lobe.
description.uz: Chakka bo'lagi lateral yuzasida yuqori va pastki chakka egatlari orasidagi burma.

role.en: Semantic memory and word meaning, recognising faces and familiar objects, and (posteriorly) perceiving visual motion.
role.uz: Semantik xotira va so'z ma'nosi, yuz va tanish narsalarni tanish, orqa qismida — ko'rish harakatini idrok etish.

clinical.en: Dominant-side lesions give word-finding and comprehension difficulties (transcortical sensory aphasia); it is affected early in semantic dementia.
clinical.uz: Dominant tomondagi zararlanish so'z topish va tushunishda qiyinchilik (transkortikal sensor afaziya) beradi; semantik demensiyada erta ta'sirlanadi.

description.en: The lowest lateral temporal gyrus, curving onto the inferior surface of the lobe. It is the final station of the ventral visual stream ('what' pathway).
description.uz: Chakka bo'lagining eng pastki lateral burmasi, bo'lakning pastki yuzasiga egilib o'tadi. Ventral ko'rish oqimining ('nima' yo'li) oxirgi bekati.

role.en: High-level visual recognition: objects, faces, written words and colours.
role.uz: Yuqori darajali ko'rish orqali tanish: narsalar, yuzlar, yozma so'zlar va ranglar.

clinical.en: Lesions cause visual agnosias — inability to recognise objects or faces (prosopagnosia, usually right-sided) despite normal vision.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ko'rish agnoziyalarini beradi — ko'rish normal bo'lsa ham narsa yoki yuzlarni tanimaslik (prozopagnoziya, odatda o'ng tomonlama).

description.en: A spindle-shaped gyrus on the underside of the temporal and occipital lobes, between the parahippocampal gyrus medially and the inferior temporal gyrus laterally.
description.uz: Chakka va ensa bo'laklarining pastki yuzasidagi urchuqsimon burma; medialda parahippokampal, lateralda pastki chakka burmasi orasida.

role.en: Contains the fusiform face area (face recognition, right-dominant) and the visual word form area (reading, left-dominant), plus colour and body-shape processing.
role.uz: Fuziform yuz maydoni (yuzlarni tanish, o'ng ustun) va ko'rish so'z shakli maydoni (o'qish, chap ustun) shu yerda; rang va tana shaklini ham qayta ishlaydi.

clinical.en: Right-sided damage → prosopagnosia (face blindness); left-sided damage → pure alexia (cannot read despite writing normally).
clinical.uz: O'ng tomon zararlanishi → prozopagnoziya (yuz ko'rligi); chap tomon → sof aleksiya (yozadi, lekin o'qiy olmaydi).

description.en: The gyrus on the medial temporal lobe that wraps around the hippocampus. Its anterior end hooks back as the uncus; its cortex includes the entorhinal area, the gateway between neocortex and hippocampus.
description.uz: Medial chakka bo'lagida hippokampni o'rab turgan burma. Oldingi uchi orqaga ilmoq bo'lib qayrilgan (uncus); po'stlog'ida neokorteks bilan hippokamp orasidagi darvoza — entorinal maydon bor.

role.en: Memory encoding and retrieval, recognition of scenes and places (parahippocampal place area), spatial navigation.
role.uz: Xotirani kodlash va qayta chaqirish, manzara va joylarni tanish (parahippokampal joy maydoni), fazoviy yo'nalish.

clinical.en: Uncal herniation from raised intracranial pressure compresses the oculomotor nerve and midbrain; the entorhinal cortex is where Alzheimer tau pathology begins.
clinical.uz: Bosh ichi bosimi oshganda uncus churrasi ko'zni harakatlantiruvchi nervni va o'rta miyani siqadi; Alzheimer kasalligida tau patologiyasi entorinal po'stloqdan boshlanadi.

description.en: A tongue-shaped gyrus on the medial occipital lobe below the calcarine sulcus, continuous forward with the parahippocampal gyrus.
description.uz: Ensa bo'lagi medial yuzasida, kalkarin egat ostidagi tilsimon burma; oldinga parahippokampal burma bilan davom etadi.

role.en: Its upper bank is part of the primary visual cortex representing the upper visual field; it also processes colour, letters and visual memory of scenes.
role.uz: Yuqori qirg'og'i yuqori ko'rish maydonini ifodalovchi birlamchi ko'rish po'stlog'ining qismi; rang, harflar va manzaralar ko'rish xotirasini ham qayta ishlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause an upper-quadrant visual field defect on the opposite side; bilateral damage can cause achromatopsia (loss of colour vision).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi tomonda yuqori kvadrant ko'rish maydoni nuqsonini beradi; ikki tomonlama zararlanish axromatopsiya (rang ko'rishning yo'qolishi) berishi mumkin.

description.en: The gyri on the lateral surface of the occipital lobe, containing extrastriate visual areas (V3–V5) and the lateral occipital complex.
description.uz: Ensa bo'lagi lateral yuzasidagi burmalar; ekstrastriat ko'rish maydonlari (V3–V5) va lateral ensa kompleksi shu yerda.

role.en: Object shape recognition and (in area V5/MT at the temporo-occipital junction) perception of motion.
role.uz: Narsa shaklini tanish va (chakka-ensa chegarasidagi V5/MT maydonida) harakatni idrok etish.

clinical.en: V5 lesions produce akinetopsia — the world is seen as a series of still frames.
clinical.uz: V5 zararlanishi akinetopsiya beradi — dunyo qator harakatsiz kadrlar kabi ko'rinadi.

description.en: The upper lateral gyrus of the occipital lobe, bordered above by the parieto-occipital sulcus; part of the dorsal visual stream.
description.uz: Ensa bo'lagining yuqori lateral burmasi, yuqoridan tepa-ensa egati bilan chegaralangan; dorsal ko'rish oqimining qismi.

role.en: Early extrastriate visual processing and spatial vision (where things are).
role.uz: Erta ekstrastriat ko'rish qayta ishlovi va fazoviy ko'rish (narsalar qayerda).

clinical.en: Lesions of the dorsal stream cause difficulty locating and reaching for objects (optic ataxia, part of Bálint syndrome when bilateral).
clinical.uz: Dorsal oqim zararlanishi narsalarni topish va ularga qo'l uzatishda qiyinchilik (optik ataksiya; ikki tomonlama bo'lsa Balint sindromining qismi) beradi.

description.en: The gyrus that caps the end of the superior temporal sulcus in the inferior parietal lobule (Brodmann area 39), at the junction of temporal, parietal and occipital lobes.
description.uz: Pastki tepa bo'lakchasida yuqori chakka egatining oxirini qoplovchi burma (Brodmann 39), chakka, tepa va ensa bo'laklari tutashgan joyda.

role.en: Links vision with language: reading, writing, number processing; also spatial attention and awareness of one's own body.
role.uz: Ko'rishni til bilan bog'laydi: o'qish, yozish, sonlar bilan ishlash; fazoviy diqqat va o'z tanasini anglash ham.

clinical.en: Left lesions → Gerstmann syndrome (agraphia, acalculia, finger agnosia, left–right confusion); right lesions → hemispatial neglect.
clinical.uz: Chap zararlanish → Gerstmann sindromi (agrafiya, akalkuliya, barmoq agnoziyasi, chap-o'ngni adashtirish); o'ng zararlanish → gemispatial e'tiborsizlik (neglect).

description.en: The gyrus that caps the end of the lateral fissure in the inferior parietal lobule (Brodmann area 40), just in front of the angular gyrus.
description.uz: Pastki tepa bo'lakchasida lateral egatning oxirini qoplovchi burma (Brodmann 40), angular burmaning oldida.

role.en: Phonological processing of language, tool use and skilled movement planning; the right side contributes to empathy and perspective taking.
role.uz: Tilning fonologik qayta ishlovi, asboblardan foydalanish va mohir harakatlarni rejalashtirish; o'ng tomon empatiya va boshqa nuqtai nazarni tushunishda qatnashadi.

clinical.en: Left lesions cause ideomotor apraxia (cannot pantomime tool use) and conduction aphasia when the arcuate fasciculus beneath is involved.
clinical.uz: Chap zararlanish ideomotor apraksiya (asbob ishlatishni ko'rsata olmaslik) va ostidagi arcuate fasciculus qo'shilsa — o'tkazuvchi afaziya beradi.

description.en: A long arched gyrus on the medial surface of each hemisphere, lying directly above the corpus callosum from front to back. It is the core of the limbic lobe.
description.uz: Har yarim shar medial yuzasida qadoq tananing bevosita ustida olddan orqaga yoysimon cho'zilgan uzun burma. Limbik bo'lakning o'zagi.

role.en: Anterior part: emotion, motivation, error monitoring, pain unpleasantness and autonomic control. Posterior part: memory retrieval and self-referential thought (default-mode network hub).
role.uz: Oldingi qismi: emotsiya, motivatsiya, xatolarni nazorat qilish, og'riqning yoqimsizligi va vegetativ boshqaruv. Orqa qismi: xotirani chaqirish va o'zi haqida fikrlash (default-mode tarmog'i markazi).

clinical.en: Bilateral anterior damage causes akinetic mutism (awake but not moving or speaking); the anterior cingulate is a target in surgery for intractable pain and OCD.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama oldingi zararlanish akinetik mutizm (uyg'oq, lekin harakat va gapirmaydi) beradi; oldingi singulyat davolab bo'lmas og'riq va OKBda jarrohlik nishoni.

description.en: A lobe of cortex hidden deep in the lateral fissure, covered by the frontal, parietal and temporal opercula. It has a short anterior and a long posterior part separated by the central sulcus of the insula.
description.uz: Lateral egat tubida yashiringan, peshona, tepa va chakka operkulalari bilan yopilgan po'stloq bo'lagi. Insula markaziy egati bilan ajratilgan qisqa oldingi va uzun orqa qismlari bor.

role.en: Interoception — feeling the state of the body (heartbeat, hunger, visceral pain), taste (anterior insula), and emotional awareness such as disgust; also vestibular and pain processing.
role.uz: Interotseptsiya — tana holatini his qilish (yurak urishi, ochlik, visseral og'riq), ta'm (oldingi insula) va jirkanish kabi emotsional anglash; vestibulyar va og'riq qayta ishlovi ham.

clinical.en: Insular strokes can cause cardiac arrhythmias and blood-pressure instability; insular seizures produce a rising epigastric sensation and fear.
clinical.uz: Insula insulti yurak aritmiyalari va qon bosimi beqarorligini keltirib chiqarishi mumkin; insula tutqanoqlari ko'tariluvchi epigastral sezgi va qo'rquv beradi.

description.en: The most medial gyrus on the orbital (under) surface of the frontal lobe, separated from the orbital gyri by the olfactory sulcus in which the olfactory tract lies.
description.uz: Peshona bo'lagi orbital (pastki) yuzasidagi eng medial burma; orbital burmalardan hidlov egati bilan ajralgan, egatda hidlov trakti yotadi.

role.en: Part of ventromedial prefrontal cortex: valuing outcomes, social behaviour and, with the neighbouring olfactory structures, smell.
role.uz: Ventromedial prefrontal po'stloqning qismi: natijalarni baholash, ijtimoiy xulq va qo'shni hidlov tuzilmalari bilan birga hid bilish.

clinical.en: Crushed against the anterior cranial fossa in frontal head injury; olfactory groove meningiomas grow here and cause anosmia and personality change.
clinical.uz: Peshona jarohatida oldingi bosh suyagi chuqurchasiga urilib ezilishi mumkin; hidlov egati meningiomalari shu yerda o'sib anosmiya va shaxsiyat o'zgarishi beradi.

description.en: One of the four orbital gyri (anterior, medial, lateral, posterior) on the under-surface of the frontal lobe, arranged around the H-shaped orbital sulcus and resting on the roof of the orbit.
description.uz: Peshona bo'lagi pastki yuzasidagi to'rt orbital burmadan biri (oldingi, medial, lateral, orqa); H-shaklidagi orbital egat atrofida joylashib, ko'z kosasi tomiga tayanadi.

role.en: Orbitofrontal cortex: assigns reward value to food, smells and social outcomes, and updates behaviour when rewards change (reversal learning).
role.uz: Orbitofrontal po'stloq: ovqat, hid va ijtimoiy natijalarga mukofot qiymatini beradi, mukofot o'zgarganda xulqni yangilaydi (teskari o'rganish).

clinical.en: Orbitofrontal damage (classic case: Phineas Gage) causes disinhibition, impulsivity and poor social judgement with intact intelligence.
clinical.uz: Orbitofrontal zararlanish (klassik holat: Phineas Gage) aql saqlangan holda tormozsizlik, impulsivlik va ijtimoiy mulohazaning buzilishini beradi.

description.en: The orbital gyrus next to the olfactory sulcus, between the straight gyrus and the H-shaped orbital sulcus.
description.uz: Hidlov egati yonidagi orbital burma; to'g'ri burma bilan H-shaklidagi orbital egat orasida.

role.en: Medial orbitofrontal cortex: reward evaluation and emotional decision making.
role.uz: Medial orbitofrontal po'stloq: mukofotni baholash va emotsional qaror qabul qilish.

clinical.en: Involved in depression and OCD circuits; damaged in frontal contusions.
clinical.uz: Depressiya va OKB zanjirlarida qatnashadi; peshona kontuziyalarida zararlanadi.

description.en: The most lateral orbital gyrus, continuous with the orbital part of the inferior frontal gyrus.
description.uz: Eng lateral orbital burma; pastki peshona burmasining orbital qismi bilan davom etadi.

role.en: Lateral orbitofrontal cortex: evaluating punishment and suppressing previously rewarded responses.
role.uz: Lateral orbitofrontal po'stloq: jazoni baholash va ilgari mukofotlangan javoblarni bostirish.

clinical.en: Dysfunction is linked to impulsive and compulsive behaviour.
clinical.uz: Buzilishi impulsiv va kompulsiv xulq bilan bog'liq.

description.en: The orbital gyrus nearest the anterior perforated substance and the temporal pole, at the back of the orbital surface.
description.uz: Orbital yuzaning orqasida, oldingi teshikli modda va chakka qutbiga eng yaqin orbital burma.

role.en: Integrates taste and smell into flavour and links them to emotional value; contains secondary olfactory cortex.
role.uz: Ta'm va hidni birlashtirib ta'm-hid hissini hosil qiladi, emotsional qiymat bilan bog'laydi; ikkilamchi hidlov po'stlog'i shu yerda.

clinical.en: Seizures here cause olfactory hallucinations; it sits over the sphenoid ridge and is vulnerable in head injury.
clinical.uz: Bu yerdagi tutqanoqlar hidlov gallyutsinatsiyalari beradi; ponasimon suyak qirrasi ustida joylashgani uchun bosh jarohatida zaif.

description.en: An almond-shaped cluster of nuclei deep in the anterior temporal lobe, just in front of the hippocampus and below the uncus. It has basolateral, central and cortical nuclear groups.
description.uz: Oldingi chakka bo'lagi tubida, hippokamp oldida va uncus ostidagi bodomsimon yadrolar to'plami. Bazolateral, markaziy va po'stloq yadro guruhlari bor.

role.en: Attaches emotional significance to experience — above all fear. It learns which stimuli are threatening and triggers the body's fear response through the hypothalamus and brainstem.
role.uz: Tajribaga emotsional ahamiyat beradi — avvalo qo'rquv. Qaysi stimullar xavfli ekanini o'rganadi va gipotalamus hamda miya ustuni orqali tananing qo'rquv javobini ishga tushiradi.

clinical.en: Bilateral damage causes Klüver–Bucy syndrome (placidity, hyperorality, hypersexuality); it is a common seizure focus in temporal lobe epilepsy and is hyperactive in anxiety and PTSD.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama zararlanish Klüver–Bucy sindromini (yuvoshlik, hamma narsani og'izga olish, giperseksuallik) beradi; chakka epilepsiyasida tez-tez tutqanoq o'chog'i, xavotir va PTSDda giperfaol.

description.en: A curved, sea-horse-shaped strip of three-layered cortex on the floor of the temporal horn of the lateral ventricle. Its sectors CA1–CA3, the dentate gyrus and the subiculum form the hippocampal formation.
description.uz: Lateral qorincha chakka shoxi tubidagi uch qatlamli, dengiz otiga o'xshash egri po'stloq tasmasi. CA1–CA3 sektorlari, tishsimon burma va subikulum hippokampal formatsiyani tashkil qiladi.

role.en: Forms new declarative memories (facts and events) and consolidates them to the cortex; also holds the cognitive map used for spatial navigation (place cells).
role.uz: Yangi deklarativ xotiralarni (faktlar va voqealar) hosil qiladi va ularni po'stloqqa mustahkamlaydi; fazoviy yo'nalish uchun kognitiv xaritani (joy hujayralari) ham saqlaydi.

clinical.en: Bilateral loss (patient H.M.) causes profound anterograde amnesia; it is the earliest site of Alzheimer atrophy and the classic origin of mesial temporal lobe epilepsy (hippocampal sclerosis). CA1 is very vulnerable to hypoxia.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama yo'qolishi (bemor H.M.) og'ir anterograd amneziya beradi; Alzheimer atrofiyasining eng erta joyi va mezial chakka epilepsiyasining klassik manbai (hippokampal skleroz). CA1 gipoksiyaga juda sezgir.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience — Memory and the hippocampus (NCBI Bookshelf)

description.en: A C-shaped nucleus of the basal ganglia that follows the curve of the lateral ventricle: a bulging head in the frontal horn, a body along the ventricle roof and a thin tail into the temporal horn. With the putamen it forms the striatum.
description.uz: Bazal yadrolarning lateral qorincha egriligini takrorlovchi C-shaklidagi yadrosi: peshona shoxidagi bo'rtgan bosh, qorincha tomi bo'ylab tana va chakka shoxiga kiruvchi ingichka dum. Putamen bilan birga striatumni tashkil qiladi.

role.en: Receives cortical input for the basal ganglia loops that select and initiate actions and habits; the head is strongly linked to prefrontal cognitive and reward circuits.
role.uz: Harakat va odatlarni tanlab ishga tushiruvchi bazal yadro halqalari uchun po'stloqdan kirish oladi; boshi prefrontal kognitiv va mukofot zanjirlari bilan mustahkam bog'langan.

clinical.en: Atrophy of the caudate head (loss of the ventricular bulge on MRI) is the hallmark of Huntington disease, which causes chorea and dementia.
clinical.uz: Kaudat boshining atrofiyasi (MRTda qorinchaga bo'rtishning yo'qolishi) — xoreya va demensiya beruvchi Xantington kasalligining belgisi.

description.en: The lateral, shell-like part of the lentiform nucleus, lying lateral to the globus pallidus and internal capsule and medial to the external capsule and claustrum. Together with the caudate it forms the striatum.
description.uz: Yasmiqsimon yadroning lateral, chig'anoqsimon qismi; globus pallidus va ichki kapsuladan lateral, tashqi kapsula va klaustrumdan medial. Kaudat bilan birga striatumni tashkil qiladi.

role.en: The motor part of the striatum: receives input from motor and somatosensory cortex and helps select, scale and automate movements.
role.uz: Striatumning harakat qismi: harakat va somatosensor po'stloqdan kirish oladi, harakatlarni tanlash, o'lchash va avtomatlashtirishda yordam beradi.

clinical.en: The commonest site of hypertensive intracerebral haemorrhage (lenticulostriate arteries); dopamine loss in its projections underlies parkinsonian bradykinesia; copper deposits here in Wilson disease.
clinical.uz: Gipertenziv miya ichi qon quyilishining eng tez-tez uchraydigan joyi (lentikulostriat arteriyalar); unga keluvchi dofamin yo'qolishi parkinsonizmdagi bradikineziyaning asosi; Vilson kasalligida mis shu yerda to'planadi.

description.en: The pale, medial part of the lentiform nucleus, divided by a thin lamina into an external (GPe) and an internal (GPi) segment.
description.uz: Yasmiqsimon yadroning oqish, medial qismi; yupqa plastinka bilan tashqi (GPe) va ichki (GPi) segmentlarga bo'lingan.

role.en: GPi is the main output of the basal ganglia: it tonically inhibits the thalamus and releases it to let a chosen movement proceed. GPe belongs to the indirect pathway that brakes unwanted movement.
role.uz: GPi bazal yadrolarning asosiy chiqishi: talamusni doimiy tormozlab turadi va tanlangan harakatga yo'l berish uchun qo'yib yuboradi. GPe istalmagan harakatni to'xtatuvchi bilvosita yo'lga kiradi.

clinical.en: GPi is a target of deep brain stimulation and pallidotomy for Parkinson disease and dystonia; bilateral pallidal necrosis follows carbon monoxide poisoning.
clinical.uz: GPi — Parkinson kasalligi va distoniyada chuqur miya stimulyatsiyasi va pallidotomiya nishoni; is gazi bilan zaharlanishda ikki tomonlama pallidum nekrozi bo'ladi.

description.en: A large egg-shaped mass of grey matter on each side of the third ventricle, forming most of the diencephalon. It is divided by the internal medullary lamina into anterior, medial and lateral nuclear groups, with the pulvinar at its posterior end.
description.uz: Uchinchi qorinchaning har ikki yonidagi katta tuxumsimon kulrang modda massasi; oraliq miyaning asosiy qismi. Ichki miya plastinkasi uni oldingi, medial va lateral yadro guruhlariga bo'ladi, orqa uchida pulvinar.

role.en: The gateway to the cortex: every sensory pathway except smell relays here (VPL/VPM for body and face sensation, LGN for vision, MGN for hearing), as do motor signals from the cerebellum and basal ganglia (VA/VL). It also regulates arousal and attention.
role.uz: Po'stloqqa darvoza: hiddan tashqari barcha sezgi yo'llari shu yerda almashadi (tana va yuz sezgisi uchun VPL/VPM, ko'rish uchun LGN, eshitish uchun MGN), miyacha va bazal yadrolardan keluvchi harakat signallari ham (VA/VL). Uyg'oqlik va diqqatni ham boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Thalamic stroke causes contralateral hemianaesthesia, sometimes followed by severe central pain (Dejerine–Roussy syndrome); bilateral paramedian infarcts cause coma or profound amnesia; VIM is the DBS target for tremor.
clinical.uz: Talamus insulti qarama-qarshi tomonda gemianesteziya, ba'zan keyin og'ir markaziy og'riq (Dejerine–Roussy sindromi) beradi; ikki tomonlama paramedian infarktlar koma yoki og'ir amneziya; VIM — tremorda DBS nishoni.

description.en: A small region below the thalamus forming the floor and lower walls of the third ventricle, from the optic chiasm in front to the mammillary bodies behind, with the pituitary stalk hanging from its tuber cinereum.
description.uz: Talamus ostidagi, uchinchi qorincha tubi va pastki devorlarini hosil qiluvchi kichik soha; olddan ko'rish kesishmasi, orqadan so'rg'ichsimon tanalar chegarasida, tuber cinereum'dan gipofiz oyoqchasi osilib turadi.

role.en: The body's control centre for homeostasis: temperature, thirst, hunger, sleep–wake rhythm, sexual behaviour and the autonomic nervous system, and the master regulator of the pituitary and hormones.
role.uz: Tananing gomeostaz boshqaruv markazi: harorat, chanqoq, ochlik, uyqu-uyg'oqlik ritmi, jinsiy xulq va vegetativ nerv tizimi; gipofiz va gormonlarning bosh boshqaruvchisi.

clinical.en: Damage (tumours, trauma, surgery) causes diabetes insipidus, obesity or wasting, temperature dysregulation and sleep disturbance; Wernicke encephalopathy affects its posterior part and the mammillary bodies.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi (o'sma, jarohat, jarrohlik) qandsiz diabet, semizlik yoki ozib ketish, harorat boshqaruvining buzilishi va uyqu buzilishini beradi; Vernike ensefalopatiyasi uning orqa qismi va so'rg'ichsimon tanalarni zararlaydi.

description.en: A nucleus of the anterior (supraoptic) hypothalamic region, above the optic chiasm.
description.uz: Ko'rish kesishmasi ustidagi oldingi (supraoptik) gipotalamus sohasi yadrosi.

role.en: Heat loss: activates sweating and skin vasodilation when the body is too warm; also promotes sleep and parasympathetic tone.
role.uz: Issiqlik yo'qotish: tana qizib ketganda terlash va teri tomirlari kengayishini ishga tushiradi; uyqu va parasimpatik tonusni ham kuchaytiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause hyperthermia (the body cannot cool itself).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi gipertermiya beradi (tana o'zini sovita olmaydi).

description.en: A nucleus of the posterior (mammillary) hypothalamic region, above and in front of the mammillary bodies.
description.uz: So'rg'ichsimon tanalar ustida va oldidagi orqa (mammillar) gipotalamus sohasi yadrosi.

role.en: Heat conservation: shivering and vasoconstriction when cold; drives sympathetic arousal and wakefulness.
role.uz: Issiqlikni saqlash: sovuqda titrash va tomirlar torayishi; simpatik faollik va uyg'oqlikni boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause hypothermia (poikilothermia) and hypersomnia.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi gipotermiya (poykilotermiya) va gipersomniya beradi.

description.en: A wedge-shaped nucleus beside the upper third ventricle, with large (magnocellular) and small (parvocellular) neurons.
description.uz: Uchinchi qorincha yuqori qismi yonidagi ponasimon yadro; yirik (magnotsellyulyar) va mayda (parvotsellyulyar) neyronlari bor.

role.en: Magnocellular cells make oxytocin and vasopressin (ADH) for the posterior pituitary; parvocellular cells release CRH and TRH to the anterior pituitary and drive the sympathetic system — the hub of the stress response.
role.uz: Magnotsellyulyar hujayralar orqa gipofiz uchun oksitotsin va vazopressin (ADH) ishlab chiqaradi; parvotsellyulyar hujayralar oldingi gipofizga CRH va TRH ajratadi va simpatik tizimni boshqaradi — stress javobining markazi.

clinical.en: Damage contributes to diabetes insipidus and disturbed stress and appetite regulation.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qandsiz diabet hamda stress va ishtaha boshqaruvining buzilishiga olib keladi.

description.en: A well-defined round nucleus in the middle (tuberal) hypothalamus, low and near the midline.
description.uz: O'rta (tuberal) gipotalamusdagi aniq chegarali yumaloq yadro; pastda, o'rta chiziqqa yaqin.

role.en: The satiety centre — signals fullness and stops eating; also involved in fear/defensive behaviour and female sexual behaviour.
role.uz: To'yish markazi — to'qlikni bildiradi va ovqatlanishni to'xtatadi; qo'rquv/himoya xulqi va ayol jinsiy xulqida ham qatnashadi.

clinical.en: Bilateral lesions cause hyperphagia and obesity, sometimes with rage ('hypothalamic obesity' after craniopharyngioma surgery).
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama zararlanish giperfagiya va semizlik, ba'zan g'azab beradi (kraniofaringioma jarrohligidan keyingi 'gipotalamik semizlik').

sources.title: Wikipedia — Ventromedial nucleus of the hypothalamus

description.en: A tuberal hypothalamic nucleus lying above the ventromedial nucleus.
description.uz: Ventromedial yadro ustida joylashgan tuberal gipotalamus yadrosi.

role.en: Coordinates circadian rhythms of feeding, activity and corticosteroid release; stimulates eating and gastrointestinal activity.
role.uz: Ovqatlanish, faollik va kortikosteroid ajralishining sutkalik ritmlarini muvofiqlashtiradi; ovqatlanish va oshqozon-ichak faolligini rag'batlantiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions blunt daily rhythms of activity and feeding.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi faollik va ovqatlanishning sutkalik ritmlarini susaytiradi.

description.en: A diffuse region lateral to the fornix and mammillothalamic tract, traversed by the medial forebrain bundle.
description.uz: Fornix va mammillotalamik traktdan lateral joylashgan tarqoq soha; medial oldingi miya tutami undan o'tadi.

role.en: The hunger centre — drives feeding and thirst; its orexin (hypocretin) neurons maintain wakefulness.
role.uz: Ochlik markazi — ovqatlanish va chanqoqni boshqaradi; oreksin (gipokretin) neyronlari uyg'oqlikni saqlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause anorexia and weight loss; loss of its orexin neurons causes narcolepsy.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi anoreksiya va ozishga olib keladi; oreksin neyronlarining yo'qolishi narkolepsiya beradi.

description.en: A nucleus in the floor of the third ventricle at the base of the pituitary stalk, outside the blood–brain barrier so it can sense hormones in the blood.
description.uz: Uchinchi qorincha tubida, gipofiz oyoqchasi asosidagi yadro; qon-miya to'sig'idan tashqarida bo'lgani uchun qondagi gormonlarni sezadi.

role.en: Senses leptin, insulin and ghrelin to balance appetite (NPY/AgRP hunger neurons vs POMC satiety neurons); releases GHRH and dopamine (which inhibits prolactin) into the portal system.
role.uz: Leptin, insulin va grelinni sezib ishtahani muvozanatlaydi (NPY/AgRP ochlik neyronlari va POMC to'qlik neyronlari); portal tizimga GHRH va dofamin (prolaktinni tormozlaydi) ajratadi.

clinical.en: Central to obesity biology and the target of GLP-1 and leptin signalling; a lesion removes the dopamine brake and raises prolactin.
clinical.uz: Semizlik biologiyasining markazi, GLP-1 va leptin signallarining nishoni; zararlansa dofamin tormozi yo'qolib prolaktin oshadi.

description.en: A pair of small round bumps on the under-surface of the hypothalamus behind the pituitary stalk, each containing medial and lateral nuclei.
description.uz: Gipofiz oyoqchasi orqasida, gipotalamus pastki yuzasidagi bir juft kichik yumaloq do'nglik; har birida medial va lateral yadrolar.

role.en: A relay of the Papez memory circuit: receives the fornix from the hippocampus and projects via the mammillothalamic tract to the anterior thalamus; important for episodic memory and spatial orientation.
role.uz: Papez xotira zanjirining uzatgichi: hippokampdan fornix orqali kirish oladi va mammillotalamik trakt orqali oldingi talamusga yuboradi; epizodik xotira va fazoviy yo'nalish uchun muhim.

clinical.en: Haemorrhagic necrosis in thiamine deficiency (Wernicke–Korsakoff syndrome) produces severe amnesia with confabulation; they are a landmark for the third ventriculostomy in neurosurgery.
clinical.uz: Tiamin yetishmovchiligida (Vernike–Korsakov sindromi) gemorragik nekrozi konfabulyatsiya bilan og'ir amneziya beradi; neyroxirurgiyada uchinchi qorincha ventrikulostomiyasi uchun mo'ljal.

description.en: A compact bundle running upward from the mammillary body to the anterior nucleus of the thalamus (tract of Vicq d'Azyr).
description.uz: So'rg'ichsimon tanadan yuqoriga, talamusning oldingi yadrosiga boruvchi ixcham tutam (Vicq d'Azyr trakti).

role.en: The mammillary-to-thalamus link of the Papez circuit for memory.
role.uz: Papez xotira zanjirida so'rg'ichsimon tana–talamus bo'g'ini.

clinical.en: Its interruption (e.g. by a thalamic infarct) is enough to cause amnesia.
clinical.uz: Uzilishi (masalan, talamus infarkti) amneziya berish uchun yetarli.

description.en: A small lens-shaped nucleus below the thalamus and above the substantia nigra, lying against the internal capsule.
description.uz: Talamus ostida va substantia nigra ustida, ichki kapsulaga tegib turuvchi kichik yasmiqsimon yadro.

role.en: The only excitatory (glutamate) nucleus of the basal ganglia: in the indirect pathway it drives the globus pallidus internus to suppress unwanted movements and to stop actions quickly.
role.uz: Bazal yadrolarning yagona qo'zg'atuvchi (glutamat) yadrosi: bilvosita yo'lda ichki globus pallidusni ishga solib istalmagan harakatlarni bostiradi va harakatni tez to'xtatadi.

clinical.en: A lesion (usually a small stroke) causes hemiballismus — violent flinging movements of the opposite limbs. It is the main target of deep brain stimulation for Parkinson disease.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi (odatda kichik insult) gemiballizm — qarama-qarshi oyoq-qo'llarning kuchli otish harakatlarini beradi. Parkinson kasalligida chuqur miya stimulyatsiyasining asosiy nishoni.

description.en: A dark band in the midbrain between the cerebral peduncle and the tegmentum, pigmented with neuromelanin. The pars compacta holds dopamine neurons; the pars reticulata is a GABAergic output nucleus.
description.uz: O'rta miyada miya oyoqchasi bilan tegmentum orasidagi, neyromelanin bilan pigmentlangan qora tasma. Pars compacta'da dofamin neyronlari, pars reticulata — GABAergik chiqish yadrosi.

role.en: Pars compacta dopamine sets the gain of the striatum, making movement initiation easy and signalling reward; pars reticulata gates eye movements and, with GPi, thalamic output.
role.uz: Pars compacta dofamini striatum sezgirligini sozlaydi, harakatni boshlashni osonlashtiradi va mukofotni bildiradi; pars reticulata ko'z harakatlari va GPi bilan birga talamus chiqishini boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Loss of pars compacta neurons (and the pigment) is the cause of Parkinson disease — tremor, rigidity, bradykinesia appear once ~60–80% are gone.
clinical.uz: Pars compacta neyronlari (va pigment) yo'qolishi Parkinson kasalligining sababi — tremor, rigidlik, bradikineziya ~60–80% yo'qolgach paydo bo'ladi.

description.en: A large round nucleus in the midbrain tegmentum at the level of the superior colliculus, pink in fresh tissue because of its iron content. Fibres of the oculomotor nerve pass through it.
description.uz: O'rta miya tegmentumida, yuqori do'nglik darajasidagi yirik yumaloq yadro; temir tarkibi tufayli yangi to'qimada pushti. Ko'zni harakatlantiruvchi nerv tolalari undan o'tadi.

role.en: Relays cerebellar output to the cortex and (via the rubrospinal tract) to the spinal cord, helping coordinate limb flexion, especially of the arms.
role.uz: Miyacha chiqishini po'stloqqa va (rubrospinal trakt orqali) orqa miyaga uzatadi; oyoq-qo'llar, ayniqsa qo'llar bukilishini muvofiqlashtirishga yordam beradi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause a coarse 'rubral' (Holmes) tremor; brainstem injury above the red nucleus produces decorticate posturing, below it decerebrate posturing.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi dag'al 'rubral' (Holmes) tremor beradi; miya ustuni qizil yadrodan yuqorida zararlansa dekortikatsion, pastda bo'lsa detserebratsion holat kuzatiladi.

description.en: A small knee-shaped swelling at the back of the thalamus below the pulvinar: the six-layered lateral geniculate nucleus, where the optic tract ends.
description.uz: Talamus orqasida, pulvinar ostidagi kichik tizzasimon bo'rtiq: ko'rish trakti tugaydigan olti qatlamli lateral tizzasimon yadro.

role.en: The thalamic relay for vision: retinal input from both eyes for the opposite visual field is passed to the primary visual cortex through the optic radiation.
role.uz: Ko'rish uchun talamik uzatgich: har ikki ko'zdan qarama-qarshi ko'rish maydoni uchun keluvchi to'r parda signali ko'rish radiatsiyasi orqali birlamchi ko'rish po'stlog'iga uzatiladi.

clinical.en: Damage causes a contralateral homonymous hemianopia; its layers are affected in glaucoma.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi tomonda gomonim gemianopsiya beradi; glaukomada qatlamlari ta'sirlanadi.

description.en: The medial of the two geniculate bodies under the pulvinar, receiving the brachium of the inferior colliculus.
description.uz: Pulvinar ostidagi ikki tizzasimon tanadan medialdagisi; pastki do'nglik brachiumini qabul qiladi.

role.en: The thalamic relay for hearing: auditory information is sent to the primary auditory cortex (Heschl's gyrus).
role.uz: Eshitish uchun talamik uzatgich: eshitish axboroti birlamchi eshitish po'stlog'iga (Heshl burmasi) yuboriladi.

clinical.en: Unilateral lesions cause only mild hearing loss because auditory pathways are bilateral.
clinical.uz: Eshitish yo'llari ikki tomonlama bo'lgani uchun bir tomonlama zararlanish faqat yengil eshitish pasayishi beradi.

description.en: A pair of small nuclei in the epithalamus beside the pineal stalk, connected to each other by the habenular commissure and receiving the stria medullaris.
description.uz: Epitalamusda, epifiz oyoqchasi yonidagi bir juft kichik yadro; o'zaro habenula komissurasi bilan bog'langan, stria medullaris'ni qabul qiladi.

role.en: Links the limbic forebrain to midbrain monoamine systems; the lateral habenula signals disappointment and inhibits dopamine neurons when an expected reward fails to arrive.
role.uz: Limbik oldingi miyani o'rta miya monoamin tizimlari bilan bog'laydi; lateral habenula kutilgan mukofot kelmasa 'umidsizlik' signalini berib dofamin neyronlarini tormozlaydi.

clinical.en: Overactivity is implicated in depression; it is under study as a DBS target for treatment-resistant depression.
clinical.uz: Giperfaolligi depressiya bilan bog'liq; davolashga chidamli depressiyada DBS nishoni sifatida o'rganilmoqda.

description.en: A small pine-cone-shaped endocrine gland in the midline behind the third ventricle, above the superior colliculi. It often calcifies with age and is visible on X-ray.
description.uz: Uchinchi qorincha orqasida, yuqori do'ngliklar ustida, o'rta chiziqdagi kichik qarag'ay g'uddasiga o'xshash endokrin bez. Yosh bilan tez-tez kalsifikatsiyalanadi va rentgenda ko'rinadi.

role.en: Secretes melatonin at night under control of the suprachiasmatic nucleus, signalling darkness and setting circadian and seasonal rhythms.
role.uz: Suprakiazmatik yadro nazorati ostida kechasi melatonin ajratadi, qorong'ilikni bildirib sutkalik va mavsumiy ritmlarni sozlaydi.

clinical.en: Pineal tumours compress the tectum (Parinaud syndrome: cannot look up) and the aqueduct (hydrocephalus); germinomas here may cause precocious puberty.
clinical.uz: Epifiz o'smalari tektumni (Parinaud sindromi: yuqoriga qaray olmaslik) va suv yo'lini (gidrotsefaliya) siqadi; germinomalar erta jinsiy yetilish berishi mumkin.

description.en: A pea-sized gland sitting in the sella turcica of the sphenoid bone, hanging from the hypothalamus by the infundibulum. The anterior lobe is glandular tissue; the posterior lobe is nervous tissue.
description.uz: Ponasimon suyakning turk egarida joylashgan, gipotalamusdan voronka (infundibulum) orqali osilib turuvchi no'xat kattaligidagi bez. Oldingi bo'lak bez to'qimasi, orqa bo'lak nerv to'qimasi.

role.en: The 'master gland': the anterior lobe secretes GH, prolactin, ACTH, TSH, FSH and LH under hypothalamic control; the posterior lobe releases oxytocin and vasopressin made in the hypothalamus.
role.uz: 'Bosh bez': oldingi bo'lak gipotalamus nazoratida GH, prolaktin, ACTH, TSH, FSH va LH ajratadi; orqa bo'lak gipotalamusda ishlangan oksitotsin va vazopressinni chiqaradi.

clinical.en: Adenomas cause hormone excess (prolactinoma, acromegaly, Cushing disease) and press on the optic chiasm above, producing bitemporal hemianopia; reached surgically through the nose (trans-sphenoidal approach).
clinical.uz: Adenomalar gormon ortiqchaligini (prolaktinoma, akromegaliya, Kushing kasalligi) beradi va yuqoridagi ko'rish kesishmasini bosib bitemporal gemianopsiya keltirib chiqaradi; jarrohlikda burun orqali (transsfenoidal yo'l) yetiladi.

description.en: The bulging middle part of the brainstem between the midbrain and the medulla, in front of the cerebellum. Its ventral part is crossed by transverse fibres that gather into the middle cerebellar peduncles; its dorsal part (tegmentum) forms the upper floor of the fourth ventricle.
description.uz: Miya ustunining o'rta miya bilan uzunchoq miya orasidagi, miyacha oldidagi bo'rtgan o'rta qismi. Ventral qismidan ko'ndalang tolalar o'tib, o'rta miyacha oyoqchalariga yig'iladi; dorsal qismi (tegmentum) to'rtinchi qorincha tubining yuqori qismini hosil qiladi.

role.en: Relays cortical motor plans to the cerebellum (pontine nuclei), carries the long motor and sensory tracts, houses the nuclei of cranial nerves V, VI, VII and VIII, and contains centres for breathing rhythm, sleep (REM) and arousal.
role.uz: Po'stloq harakat rejalarini miyachaga uzatadi (ko'prik yadrolari), uzun harakat va sezgi yo'llarini o'tkazadi, V, VI, VII, VIII bosh nervlari yadrolarini saqlaydi, nafas ritmi, uyqu (REM) va uyg'oqlik markazlarini o'z ichiga oladi.

clinical.en: Pontine haemorrhage causes coma with pinpoint pupils; a basilar artery occlusion can produce locked-in syndrome (awake but paralysed except for vertical eye movements); rapid correction of hyponatraemia causes central pontine myelinolysis.
clinical.uz: Ko'prikka qon quyilishi nuqtasimon qorachiqlar bilan koma beradi; bazilyar arteriya tiqilishi 'qulflangan odam' sindromini (uyg'oq, lekin vertikal ko'z harakatlaridan tashqari falaj) keltirib chiqarishi mumkin; giponatriemiyani tez tuzatish markaziy ko'prik miyelinolizi beradi.

description.en: The lowest part of the brainstem, continuous with the spinal cord at the foramen magnum. On its front are the pyramids (corticospinal tracts) and the olives; on its back the lower floor of the fourth ventricle.
description.uz: Miya ustunining eng pastki qismi; katta teshik darajasida orqa miyaga o'tadi. Old yuzasida piramidalar (kortikospinal traktlar) va zaytunlar, orqasida to'rtinchi qorincha tubining pastki qismi.

role.en: Vital centres: it sets the rhythm of breathing, controls heart rate and blood pressure, and coordinates swallowing, vomiting, coughing and sneezing; the corticospinal fibres cross in its pyramids, and cranial nerves IX–XII arise from it.
role.uz: Hayotiy markazlar: nafas ritmini belgilaydi, yurak urishi va qon bosimini boshqaradi, yutish, qusish, yo'tal va aksirishni muvofiqlashtiradi; kortikospinal tolalar uning piramidalarida kesishadi, IX–XII bosh nervlari undan chiqadi.

clinical.en: Lateral medullary (Wallenberg) syndrome from PICA/vertebral occlusion: vertigo, dysphagia, ipsilateral face and contralateral body pain loss, Horner syndrome; tonsillar herniation compresses the medulla and stops breathing.
clinical.uz: PICA/vertebral tiqilishidan lateral medullar (Vallenberg) sindromi: bosh aylanishi, disfagiya, o'sha tomonda yuz va qarama-qarshi tomonda tana og'riq sezgisining yo'qolishi, Horner sindromi; miyacha bodomchalari churrasi uzunchoq miyani siqib nafasni to'xtatadi.

description.en: The upper pair of bumps on the roof (tectum) of the midbrain, layered like a small cortex, receiving direct input from the retina and the visual cortex.
description.uz: O'rta miya tomidagi (tektum) yuqori juft do'nglik; kichik po'stloq kabi qatlamli, to'r parda va ko'rish po'stlog'idan bevosita kirish oladi.

role.en: Directs the eyes and head toward things that appear in the visual field (saccades and orienting), combining sight, sound and touch in a map of space.
role.uz: Ko'rish maydonida paydo bo'lgan narsalarga ko'z va boshni yo'naltiradi (sakkadalar va mo'ljal olish); ko'rish, tovush va sezgini fazo xaritasida birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Compression by a pineal tumour causes Parinaud syndrome — paralysis of upward gaze and light-near pupil dissociation.
clinical.uz: Epifiz o'smasi bilan siqilishi Parinaud sindromini — yuqoriga qarash falaji va qorachiqning yorug'lik-yaqinlik dissotsiatsiyasini beradi.

description.en: The lower pair of bumps on the midbrain tectum, the main midbrain station of the auditory pathway; its brachium carries output to the medial geniculate body.
description.uz: O'rta miya tektumidagi pastki juft do'nglik, eshitish yo'lining o'rta miyadagi asosiy bekati; brachiumi chiqishni medial tizzasimon tanaga olib boradi.

role.en: Integrates sound from both ears to locate its source and drives the startle and orienting reflexes to sudden sounds.
role.uz: Ikkala quloqdan keluvchi tovushni birlashtirib manbasini aniqlaydi; to'satdan tovushga cho'chish va mo'ljal olish reflekslarini boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Bilateral lesions impair sound localisation; it is a site of auditory processing changes in tinnitus.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama zararlanish tovush manbasini aniqlashni buzadi; tinnitusda eshitish qayta ishlovi o'zgarishlari joyi.

description.en: The 'little brain' in the posterior cranial fossa, behind the pons and medulla and under the tentorium. Two hemispheres flank the midline vermis; the surface is folded into fine folia, and deep inside lie the dentate, interposed and fastigial nuclei. It connects to the brainstem by three pairs of peduncles.
description.uz: Orqa bosh suyagi chuqurchasidagi 'kichik miya'; ko'prik va uzunchoq miya orqasida, tentorium ostida. Ikki yarim shar o'rta chiziqdagi chuvalchangni (vermis) o'rab turadi; yuzasi mayda burmalarga (folia) bukilgan, ichida tishsimon, oraliq va fastigial yadrolar. Miya ustuni bilan uch juft oyoqcha orqali bog'lanadi.

role.en: Makes movement smooth and accurate: compares the intended movement with sensory feedback and corrects errors in real time; controls balance (vestibulocerebellum), posture and gait (spinocerebellum) and the planning of skilled limb movements (cerebrocerebellum). It also supports motor learning and some cognitive timing.
role.uz: Harakatni silliq va aniq qiladi: mo'ljallangan harakatni sezgi qayta aloqasi bilan solishtirib xatolarni real vaqtda tuzatadi; muvozanat (vestibulotserebellum), gavda holati va yurish (spinotserebellum) hamda mohir harakatlarni rejalashtirishni (tserebrotserebellum) boshqaradi. Harakat o'rganish va ba'zi kognitiv vaqt hisobini ham qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause ipsilateral ataxia, intention tremor, dysmetria, nystagmus and slurred (scanning) speech — without weakness. Cerebellar haemorrhage or a swelling infarct can compress the fourth ventricle (hydrocephalus) and the brainstem, a neurosurgical emergency.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi o'sha tomonda ataksiya, intension tremor, dismetriya, nistagm va bo'g'iq (skandirlangan) nutq beradi — kuchsizliksiz. Miyachaga qon quyilishi yoki shishgan infarkt to'rtinchi qorinchani (gidrotsefaliya) va miya ustunini siqadi — neyroxirurgik shoshilinch holat.

description.en: The large C-shaped CSF cavity inside each cerebral hemisphere: a frontal horn, a body, and occipital and temporal horns, wrapped around the thalamus and caudate. It opens into the third ventricle through the interventricular foramen.
description.uz: Har bir bosh miya yarim shari ichidagi katta C-shaklidagi likvor bo'shlig'i: peshona shoxi, tana, ensa va chakka shoxlari; talamus va kaudatni o'rab turadi. Qorinchalararo teshik orqali uchinchi qorinchaga ochiladi.

role.en: Its choroid plexus produces most of the cerebrospinal fluid, which cushions the brain, carries away waste and keeps its chemical environment stable.
role.uz: Tomirli chigali orqa miya suyuqligining ko'p qismini ishlab chiqaradi; likvor miyani himoyalaydi, chiqindilarni olib ketadi va kimyoviy muhitni barqaror tutadi.

clinical.en: Enlarges in hydrocephalus and in brain atrophy; the frontal horn is the usual entry point for an external ventricular drain or shunt (Kocher's point).
clinical.uz: Gidrotsefaliya va miya atrofiyasida kengayadi; peshona shoxi — tashqi qorincha drenaji yoki shunt uchun odatiy kirish nuqtasi (Kocher nuqtasi).

description.en: A narrow midline slit between the two thalami and above the hypothalamus, crossed by the interthalamic adhesion. It receives CSF from the lateral ventricles and drains through the cerebral aqueduct.
description.uz: Ikki talamus orasida, gipotalamus ustidagi tor o'rta chiziq yorig'i; talamuslararo bitishma undan o'tadi. Lateral qorinchalardan likvor oladi va miya suv yo'li orqali oqizadi.

role.en: CSF pathway and a landmark: its floor is the hypothalamus, its front wall the lamina terminalis, its roof the tela choroidea.
role.uz: Likvor yo'li va mo'ljal: tubi gipotalamus, oldingi devori lamina terminalis, tomi tela choroidea.

clinical.en: Colloid cysts at its roof can block the foramina and cause sudden hydrocephalus; endoscopic third ventriculostomy pierces its floor to treat obstructive hydrocephalus.
clinical.uz: Tomidagi kolloid kistalar teshiklarni yopib to'satdan gidrotsefaliya berishi mumkin; endoskopik uchinchi qorincha ventrikulostomiyasi obstruktiv gidrotsefaliyani davolash uchun uning tubini teshadi.

description.en: A narrow channel about 15 mm long running through the midbrain from the third to the fourth ventricle, surrounded by the periaqueductal grey.
description.uz: O'rta miya orqali uchinchi qorinchadan to'rtinchi qorinchaga o'tuvchi ~15 mm uzunlikdagi tor kanal; atrofida suv yo'li atrofi kulrang moddasi.

role.en: The narrowest point of the CSF pathway; the surrounding periaqueductal grey modulates pain and defensive behaviour.
role.uz: Likvor yo'lining eng tor joyi; atrofidagi kulrang modda og'riq va himoya xulqini boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Its stenosis (congenital or from tumours) is a classic cause of obstructive hydrocephalus.
clinical.uz: Torayishi (tug'ma yoki o'smalardan) obstruktiv gidrotsefaliyaning klassik sababi.

description.en: A tent-shaped cavity between the pons and medulla in front and the cerebellum behind. Its rhomboid floor carries the facial colliculus and the vagal and hypoglossal trigones; CSF leaves through the median (Magendie) and lateral (Luschka) apertures.
description.uz: Old tomonda ko'prik va uzunchoq miya, orqada miyacha orasidagi chodirsimon bo'shliq. Rombsimon tubida yuz do'ngligi hamda vagus va hypoglossus uchburchaklari; likvor o'rta (Magendie) va lateral (Luschka) teshiklar orqali chiqadi.

role.en: The exit of CSF into the subarachnoid space; its floor is a map of brainstem cranial nerve nuclei used by surgeons.
role.uz: Likvorning subaraxnoidal bo'shliqqa chiqish joyi; tubi jarrohlar foydalanadigan miya ustuni bosh nervi yadrolari xaritasi.

clinical.en: Medulloblastoma and ependymoma arise here in children and cause hydrocephalus; the 'safe entry zones' of its floor guide brainstem surgery.
clinical.uz: Bolalarda medulloblastoma va ependimoma shu yerda paydo bo'lib gidrotsefaliya beradi; tubidagi 'xavfsiz kirish zonalari' miya ustuni jarrohligiga yo'l ko'rsatadi.

description.en: The opening between the frontal horn of each lateral ventricle and the third ventricle, bounded by the fornix in front and the thalamus behind.
description.uz: Har lateral qorincha peshona shoxi bilan uchinchi qorincha orasidagi teshik; oldidan fornix, orqadan talamus bilan chegaralangan.

role.en: Lets CSF flow from the lateral ventricles into the third ventricle.
role.uz: Likvorning lateral qorinchalardan uchinchi qorinchaga oqishiga yo'l beradi.

clinical.en: Obstruction (colloid cyst, tumour) causes acute hydrocephalus of one or both lateral ventricles.
clinical.uz: Tiqilishi (kolloid kista, o'sma) bir yoki ikkala lateral qorinchada o'tkir gidrotsefaliya beradi.

description.en: A frond-like network of capillaries covered by secretory ependymal cells, hanging into the lateral, third and fourth ventricles.
description.uz: Lateral, uchinchi va to'rtinchi qorinchalarga osilib turuvchi, sekretor ependima hujayralari bilan qoplangan barg-shoxsimon kapillyarlar to'ri.

role.en: Secretes about 500 ml of cerebrospinal fluid a day and forms the blood–CSF barrier.
role.uz: Kuniga ~500 ml orqa miya suyuqligi ajratadi va qon–likvor to'sig'ini hosil qiladi.

clinical.en: Choroid plexus papillomas overproduce CSF and cause hydrocephalus; it calcifies with age (a normal finding on CT).
clinical.uz: Tomirli chigal papillomalari ortiqcha likvor ishlab chiqarib gidrotsefaliya beradi; yosh bilan kalsifikatsiyalanadi (KTda normal topilma).

description.en: The largest white-matter bundle of the brain — about 200 million axons — arching over the lateral ventricles to join the two hemispheres. From front to back: rostrum, genu, body and splenium.
description.uz: Miyaning eng katta oq modda tutami — ~200 million akson — lateral qorinchalar ustidan yoysimon o'tib ikki yarim sharni bog'laydi. Olddan orqaga: rostrum, genu (tizza), tana va splenium.

role.en: Transfers sensory, motor and cognitive information between the hemispheres so the two halves act as one brain.
role.uz: Sezgi, harakat va kognitiv axborotni yarim sharlar orasida uzatadi, shunda ikki yarim bitta miya kabi ishlaydi.

clinical.en: Surgical section (callosotomy for severe epilepsy) produces split-brain phenomena; agenesis is a common congenital anomaly; 'butterfly' glioblastomas spread across it.
clinical.uz: Jarrohlik kesilishi (og'ir epilepsiyada kallozotomiya) 'ajratilgan miya' hodisalarini beradi; agenezi tez-tez uchraydigan tug'ma anomaliya; 'kapalak' glioblastomalar u orqali tarqaladi.

description.en: A small round bundle crossing the midline in the front wall of the third ventricle, just in front of the fornix columns.
description.uz: Uchinchi qorincha oldingi devorida, fornix ustunlari oldidan o'rta chiziqni kesib o'tuvchi kichik yumaloq tutam.

role.en: Connects the two temporal lobes, amygdalae and olfactory regions.
role.uz: Ikki chakka bo'lagi, amigdalalar va hidlov sohalarini bog'laydi.

clinical.en: A key landmark in stereotactic neurosurgery: the AC–PC line defines the coordinate system for deep brain stimulation.
clinical.uz: Stereotaktik neyroxirurgiyada asosiy mo'ljal: AC–PC chizig'i chuqur miya stimulyatsiyasi koordinata tizimini belgilaydi.

description.en: A small fibre bundle crossing above the entrance of the cerebral aqueduct, below the pineal gland.
description.uz: Miya suv yo'li kirish qismi ustida, epifiz ostidan kesib o'tuvchi kichik tola tutami.

role.en: Carries fibres of the pupillary light reflex between the pretectal nuclei so both pupils constrict together.
role.uz: Qorachiq yorug'lik refleksi tolalarini pretektal yadrolar orasida o'tkazadi, shunda ikkala qorachiq birga torayadi.

clinical.en: The posterior point of the AC–PC line; compression here contributes to Parinaud syndrome.
clinical.uz: AC–PC chizig'ining orqa nuqtasi; bu yerdagi siqilish Parinaud sindromiga hissa qo'shadi.

description.en: A thick V-shaped sheet of white matter between the caudate and thalamus medially and the lentiform nucleus laterally. It has an anterior limb, a genu and a posterior limb, and continues down into the cerebral peduncle.
description.uz: Medialda kaudat va talamus, lateralda yasmiqsimon yadro orasidagi qalin V-shaklidagi oq modda plastinkasi. Oldingi oyoq, tizza va orqa oyoqdan iborat, pastga miya oyoqchasiga davom etadi.

role.en: The motorway of the hemisphere: the corticospinal and corticobulbar tracts descend through the genu and posterior limb, and thalamocortical sensory fibres ascend through it.
role.uz: Yarim sharning magistral yo'li: kortikospinal va kortikobulbar traktlar tizza va orqa oyoq orqali pastga tushadi, talamokortikal sezgi tolalari u orqali ko'tariladi.

clinical.en: A small lacunar infarct in the posterior limb causes pure motor hemiparesis of the face, arm and leg — one of the commonest stroke syndromes.
clinical.uz: Orqa oyoqdagi kichik lakunar infarkt yuz, qo'l va oyoqning sof harakat gemiparezini beradi — eng ko'p uchraydigan insult sindromlaridan biri.

description.en: A C-shaped bundle arching from the hippocampus (as the fimbria and crus) under the corpus callosum (body) and down as columns behind the anterior commissure to the mammillary bodies.
description.uz: Hippokampdan (fimbria va crus sifatida) qadoq tana ostidan (tana) yoysimon o'tib, oldingi komissura orqasidan ustunlar bo'lib so'rg'ichsimon tanalarga tushuvchi C-shaklidagi tutam.

role.en: The main output of the hippocampus and the first link of the Papez memory circuit.
role.uz: Hippokampning asosiy chiqishi va Papez xotira zanjirining birinchi bo'g'ini.

clinical.en: Injury (e.g. during third ventricle surgery) causes anterograde amnesia; a DBS target under study for Alzheimer disease.
clinical.uz: Jarohatlanishi (masalan, uchinchi qorincha jarrohligida) anterograd amneziya beradi; Alzheimer kasalligida o'rganilayotgan DBS nishoni.

description.en: A slender fibre bundle running from the amygdala along the groove between the caudate and thalamus to the hypothalamus and septal area, alongside the thalamostriate vein.
description.uz: Amigdaladan kaudat bilan talamus orasidagi egat bo'ylab gipotalamus va septal sohaga boruvchi ingichka tola tutami; talamostriat vena bilan yonma-yon.

role.en: The main output of the amygdala for autonomic and hormonal fear and stress responses; its bed nucleus mediates sustained anxiety.
role.uz: Amigdalaning vegetativ va gormonal qo'rquv-stress javoblari uchun asosiy chiqishi; uning yadrosi (BNST) uzoq davom etuvchi xavotirni ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Implicated in anxiety disorders and addiction relapse.
clinical.uz: Xavotir buzilishlari va giyohvandlik qaytalanishida ishtirok etadi.

description.en: About twenty thin bundles of unmyelinated axons from the olfactory receptor cells in the nasal roof, passing through the cribriform plate of the ethmoid to the olfactory bulb.
description.uz: Burun bo'shlig'i tomidagi hidlov retseptor hujayralaridan chiqib, g'alvirsimon suyakning teshikli plastinkasi orqali hidlov piyozchasiga o'tuvchi ~20 ta ingichka miyelinsiz akson tutami.

role.en: Smell — the only sensory pathway that reaches the cortex without a thalamic relay.
role.uz: Hid bilish — talamus orqali o'tmasdan po'stloqqa yetadigan yagona sezgi yo'li.

clinical.en: Torn in head injuries with cribriform plate fracture (anosmia, CSF rhinorrhoea); smell loss is an early sign of Parkinson and Alzheimer disease.
clinical.uz: Teshikli plastinka sinishi bilan bosh jarohatlarida uziladi (anosmiya, likvor rinoreyasi); hid bilishning yo'qolishi Parkinson va Alzheimer kasalligining erta belgisi.

description.en: A flat band running back from the olfactory bulb in the olfactory sulcus under the frontal lobe, splitting into medial and lateral striae in front of the anterior perforated substance.
description.uz: Hidlov piyozchasidan peshona bo'lagi ostidagi hidlov egatida orqaga boruvchi yassi tasma; oldingi teshikli modda oldida medial va lateral striyalarga bo'linadi.

role.en: Carries processed smell information to the piriform cortex, amygdala and entorhinal cortex.
role.uz: Qayta ishlangan hid axborotini piriform po'stloq, amigdala va entorinal po'stloqqa olib boradi.

clinical.en: Compressed by olfactory groove meningiomas; Foster Kennedy syndrome combines anosmia, ipsilateral optic atrophy and contralateral papilloedema.
clinical.uz: Hidlov egati meningiomalari bilan siqiladi; Foster Kennedy sindromi anosmiya, o'sha tomonda ko'rish nervi atrofiyasi va qarama-qarshi tomonda papilla shishini birlashtiradi.

description.en: About one million axons of retinal ganglion cells leaving the back of the eye, passing through the optic canal to the chiasm. It is really a tract of the CNS, wrapped in meninges and myelinated by oligodendrocytes.
description.uz: Ko'zning orqasidan chiqib, ko'rish kanali orqali kesishmaga boruvchi ~1 million to'r parda ganglioz hujayra aksoni. Aslida MNTning trakti — miya pardalari bilan o'ralgan va oligodendrotsitlar bilan miyelinlangan.

role.en: Carries vision from the retina; also the afferent limb of the pupillary light reflex.
role.uz: To'r pardadan ko'rish axborotini olib boradi; qorachiq yorug'lik refleksining afferent bo'g'ini ham.

clinical.en: Optic neuritis (often the first sign of multiple sclerosis) causes painful monocular visual loss with a relative afferent pupillary defect; raised intracranial pressure swells the disc (papilloedema).
clinical.uz: Ko'rish nervi nevriti (ko'pincha tarqoq sklerozning birinchi belgisi) nisbiy afferent qorachiq nuqsoni bilan og'riqli bir tomonlama ko'rish pasayishi beradi; bosh ichi bosimi oshganda disk shishadi (papilloedema).

description.en: The X-shaped crossing of the optic nerves above the pituitary and in front of the hypothalamus, where fibres from the nasal half of each retina cross to the other side.
description.uz: Gipofiz ustida va gipotalamus oldidagi ko'rish nervlarining X-shaklidagi kesishmasi; har to'r pardaning burun yarmi tolalari qarama-qarshi tomonga o'tadi.

role.en: Sorts visual fibres so each optic tract carries the opposite visual field from both eyes.
role.uz: Ko'rish tolalarini shunday saralaydiki, har ko'rish trakti ikkala ko'zdan qarama-qarshi ko'rish maydonini olib boradi.

clinical.en: Compression from below by a pituitary adenoma cuts the crossing fibres → bitemporal hemianopia (tunnel vision).
clinical.uz: Gipofiz adenomasi pastdan siqib kesishuvchi tolalarni buzadi → bitemporal gemianopsiya (tunnel ko'rish).

description.en: The continuation of the visual pathway from the chiasm around the cerebral peduncle to the lateral geniculate body, with branches to the superior colliculus and pretectum.
description.uz: Ko'rish yo'lining kesishmadan miya oyoqchasi atrofidan lateral tizzasimon tanaga davomi; yuqori do'nglik va pretektumga shoxlari bor.

role.en: Carries the opposite visual field from both eyes toward the thalamus and the reflex centres.
role.uz: Ikkala ko'zdan qarama-qarshi ko'rish maydonini talamus va refleks markazlariga olib boradi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause an incongruous contralateral homonymous hemianopia, often with a relative afferent pupillary defect.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi nomutanosib qarama-qarshi gomonim gemianopsiya, ko'pincha nisbiy afferent qorachiq nuqsoni bilan beradi.

description.en: Leaves the midbrain between the cerebral peduncles, runs between the posterior cerebral and superior cerebellar arteries, along the wall of the cavernous sinus and through the superior orbital fissure into the orbit.
description.uz: O'rta miyadan miya oyoqchalari orasidan chiqadi, orqa miya va yuqori miyacha arteriyalari orasidan, g'orsimon sinus devori bo'ylab va yuqori ko'z kosasi yorig'i orqali ko'z kosasiga kiradi.

role.en: Moves the eye (all extraocular muscles except lateral rectus and superior oblique), lifts the eyelid, and carries parasympathetic fibres that constrict the pupil and focus the lens.
role.uz: Ko'zni harakatlantiradi (lateral to'g'ri va yuqori qiyshiq mushakdan tashqari barcha mushaklar), qovoqni ko'taradi, qorachiqni toraytiruvchi va gavharni fokuslovchi parasimpatik tolalarni olib boradi.

clinical.en: Palsy → ptosis, eye 'down and out', diplopia. A dilated pupil points to compression (posterior communicating aneurysm, uncal herniation); a spared pupil suggests diabetic microvascular palsy.
clinical.uz: Falaji → ptoz, ko'z 'pastga va tashqariga', diplopiya. Kengaygan qorachiq siqilishni (orqa bog'lovchi arteriya anevrizmasi, uncus churrasi) ko'rsatadi; qorachiq saqlangan bo'lsa diabetik mikrovaskulyar falaj ehtimoli.

description.en: The thinnest cranial nerve and the only one leaving the back of the brainstem; it crosses inside the midbrain, winds around the cerebral peduncle and enters the orbit through the superior orbital fissure.
description.uz: Eng ingichka bosh nervi va miya ustuni orqasidan chiquvchi yagona nerv; o'rta miya ichida kesishadi, miya oyoqchasini aylanib o'tib yuqori ko'z kosasi yorig'i orqali ko'z kosasiga kiradi.

role.en: Supplies the superior oblique muscle, which turns the eye down and in (and intorts it).
role.uz: Ko'zni pastga va ichkariga buruvchi (hamda ichkariga aylantiruvchi) yuqori qiyshiq mushakni innervatsiya qiladi.

clinical.en: Palsy causes vertical diplopia worst when looking down (stairs, reading); patients tilt the head away from the affected side. Its long course makes it vulnerable in head trauma.
clinical.uz: Falaji pastga qaraganda (zina, o'qish) kuchayuvchi vertikal diplopiya beradi; bemor boshini zararlangan tomondan teskari egadi. Uzun yo'li tufayli bosh jarohatida zaif.

description.en: The largest cranial nerve, leaving the side of the pons with a large sensory and a small motor root. Its trigeminal (Gasserian) ganglion in Meckel's cave gives off three divisions: ophthalmic (V1), maxillary (V2) and mandibular (V3).
description.uz: Eng katta bosh nervi; ko'prik yonidan katta sezgi va kichik harakat ildizi bilan chiqadi. Meckel g'oridagi uch shoxli (Gasser) tuguni uchta shox beradi: ko'z (V1), yuqori jag' (V2) va pastki jag' (V3).

role.en: Sensation of the face, scalp, cornea, teeth, mouth and dura; motor supply to the chewing muscles (via V3); afferent limb of the corneal reflex.
role.uz: Yuz, bosh terisi, shox parda, tishlar, og'iz va qattiq parda sezgisi; chaynov mushaklarining harakati (V3 orqali); shox parda refleksining afferent bo'g'ini.

clinical.en: Trigeminal neuralgia — brief electric shocks of facial pain, usually from an artery (SCA) compressing the root; treated with carbamazepine or microvascular decompression. Herpes zoster of V1 threatens the eye.
clinical.uz: Uch shoxli nerv nevralgiyasi — yuzda qisqa elektr zarbasiga o'xshash og'riq, odatda ildizni siquvchi arteriya (SCA) tufayli; karbamazepin yoki mikrovaskulyar dekompressiya bilan davolanadi. V1 zonasidagi zoster ko'zga xavf soladi.

description.en: The first, purely sensory division of the trigeminal nerve, passing in the lateral wall of the cavernous sinus and through the superior orbital fissure.
description.uz: Uch shoxli nervning birinchi, sof sezgi shoxi; g'orsimon sinus lateral devorida va yuqori ko'z kosasi yorig'i orqali o'tadi.

role.en: Sensation of the forehead, scalp to the vertex, upper eyelid, cornea and nose bridge; afferent limb of the corneal reflex.
role.uz: Peshona, bosh terisi (tepagacha), yuqori qovoq, shox parda va burun qirrasi sezgisi; shox parda refleksining afferent bo'g'ini.

clinical.en: Herpes zoster ophthalmicus can scar the cornea (Hutchinson's sign on the nose tip warns of eye involvement).
clinical.uz: Ko'z zosteri shox pardada chandiq qoldirishi mumkin (burun uchidagi Hutchinson belgisi ko'z zararlanishidan ogohlantiradi).

description.en: The third and largest trigeminal division, the only one with motor fibres, leaving the skull through the foramen ovale.
description.uz: Uch shoxli nervning uchinchi va eng katta shoxi, harakat tolalari bo'lgan yagonasi; bosh suyagidan oval teshik orqali chiqadi.

role.en: Sensation of the lower face, lower teeth, anterior two-thirds of the tongue and the ear region; motor supply to the muscles of mastication, tensor tympani and tensor veli palatini.
role.uz: Pastki yuz, pastki tishlar, tilning oldingi uchdan ikki qismi va quloq atrofi sezgisi; chaynov mushaklari, tensor tympani va tensor veli palatini harakati.

clinical.en: A motor lesion makes the jaw deviate toward the weak side when opening; the inferior alveolar branch is the target of dental anaesthesia.
clinical.uz: Harakat zararlanishida og'iz ochilganda jag' zaif tomonga og'adi; pastki alveolyar shoxi stomatologik anesteziya nishoni.

description.en: Leaves the brainstem at the pontomedullary junction, climbs the clivus, bends sharply over the petrous apex (Dorello's canal) and runs through the middle of the cavernous sinus to the orbit.
description.uz: Miya ustunidan ko'prik-uzunchoq miya chegarasida chiqadi, clivus bo'ylab ko'tariladi, toshsimon qism uchi ustidan keskin egiladi (Dorello kanali) va g'orsimon sinus o'rtasidan ko'z kosasiga o'tadi.

role.en: Supplies the lateral rectus, which turns the eye outward.
role.uz: Ko'zni tashqariga buruvchi lateral to'g'ri mushakni innervatsiya qiladi.

clinical.en: Palsy → horizontal diplopia and a convergent squint. Its long intracranial course makes it a 'false localising sign' of raised intracranial pressure.
clinical.uz: Falaji → gorizontal diplopiya va yaqinlashuvchi g'ilaylik. Bosh suyagi ichidagi uzun yo'li tufayli bosh ichi bosimi oshganda 'yolg'on lokalizatsiya belgisi' bo'ladi.

description.en: Leaves the pontomedullary junction beside CN VIII, crosses the cerebellopontine angle into the internal acoustic meatus, takes a long tortuous course through the temporal bone (geniculate ganglion) and exits at the stylomastoid foramen to fan out in the parotid gland.
description.uz: Ko'prik-uzunchoq miya chegarasidan VIII nerv yonida chiqadi, miyacha-ko'prik burchagini kesib ichki eshituv yo'liga kiradi, chakka suyagi ichida uzun egri yo'l o'tadi (tizzasimon tugun) va bigizsimon-so'rg'ichsimon teshikdan chiqib quloq oldi bezida shoxlanadi.

role.en: Muscles of facial expression, taste from the anterior two-thirds of the tongue (chorda tympani), the stapedius, and parasympathetic supply to the lacrimal, submandibular and sublingual glands.
role.uz: Mimika mushaklari, tilning oldingi uchdan ikki qismidan ta'm (chorda tympani), stapedius mushagi va ko'z yosh, jag' osti va til osti bezlarining parasimpatik innervatsiyasi.

clinical.en: Bell's palsy — sudden lower motor neuron weakness of the whole half-face (forehead included), unlike a stroke which spares the forehead. Also injured by parotid surgery, temporal bone fracture and acoustic neuroma.
clinical.uz: Bell falaji — yuzning butun yarmining (peshona ham) to'satdan pastki motoneyron kuchsizligi; insultda esa peshona saqlanadi. Quloq oldi bezi jarrohligi, chakka suyagi sinishi va akustik nevromada ham zararlanadi.

description.en: Formed by the cochlear and vestibular nerves from the inner ear, it runs through the internal acoustic meatus with the facial nerve and enters the brainstem at the cerebellopontine angle.
description.uz: Ichki quloqdan keluvchi chig'anoq va vestibulyar nervlardan hosil bo'lib, yuz nervi bilan birga ichki eshituv yo'lidan o'tadi va miyacha-ko'prik burchagida miya ustuniga kiradi.

role.en: Hearing (cochlear part) and balance, head position and acceleration (vestibular part).
role.uz: Eshitish (chig'anoq qismi) hamda muvozanat, bosh holati va tezlanish (vestibulyar qismi).

clinical.en: Vestibular schwannoma (acoustic neuroma) grows on it in the cerebellopontine angle: progressive one-sided hearing loss, tinnitus, imbalance, later facial numbness. Aminoglycosides and cisplatin are toxic to it.
clinical.uz: Vestibulyar shvannoma (akustik nevroma) miyacha-ko'prik burchagida unda o'sadi: bir tomonlama asta-sekin eshitish pasayishi, quloq shang'illashi, muvozanat buzilishi, keyin yuz uvishishi. Aminoglikozidlar va sisplatin unga toksik.

description.en: Leaves the lateral medulla behind the olive with CN X and XI and exits the skull through the jugular foramen.
description.uz: Uzunchoq miyaning lateral yuzasidan, zaytun orqasidan X va XI nervlar bilan chiqadi va bosh suyagidan bo'yinturuq teshigi orqali chiqadi.

role.en: Sensation and taste from the posterior third of the tongue and pharynx, the carotid sinus and body (blood pressure and oxygen sensing), the stylopharyngeus muscle, and parasympathetic supply to the parotid gland; afferent limb of the gag reflex.
role.uz: Tilning orqa uchdan biri va halqum sezgisi hamda ta'mi, uyqu arteriyasi sinusi va tanachasi (qon bosimi va kislorod sezish), stylopharyngeus mushagi va quloq oldi bezining parasimpatik innervatsiyasi; qusish refleksining afferent bo'g'ini.

clinical.en: Glossopharyngeal neuralgia — stabbing throat/ear pain on swallowing, sometimes with syncope; injured with X and XI in jugular foramen tumours (Vernet syndrome).
clinical.uz: Til-halqum nervi nevralgiyasi — yutganda tomoq/quloqda sanchuvchi og'riq, ba'zan hushdan ketish bilan; bo'yinturuq teshigi o'smalarida X va XI bilan birga zararlanadi (Vernet sindromi).

description.en: The 'wandering' nerve: leaves the lateral medulla, exits through the jugular foramen and descends in the carotid sheath through the neck into the chest and abdomen.
description.uz: 'Sayr qiluvchi' nerv: uzunchoq miyaning lateral yuzasidan chiqib, bo'yinturuq teshigi orqali o'tadi va uyqu arteriyasi qinida bo'yindan ko'krak va qorin bo'shlig'iga tushadi.

role.en: Parasympathetic control of the heart, lungs and gut down to the splenic flexure; motor to the pharynx and larynx (speech and swallowing); sensation from the pharynx, larynx, viscera and part of the ear; efferent limb of the gag reflex.
role.uz: Yurak, o'pka va ichakning taloq egilmasigacha parasimpatik boshqaruvi; halqum va hiqildoq harakati (nutq va yutish); halqum, hiqildoq, ichki a'zolar va quloqning bir qismidan sezgi; qusish refleksining efferent bo'g'ini.

clinical.en: Lesions cause hoarseness, dysphagia, a uvula deviating away from the side of the lesion and loss of the gag reflex; the recurrent laryngeal branch is at risk in thyroid surgery; vagus nerve stimulation treats epilepsy and depression.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi bo'g'iq ovoz, disfagiya, tilchaning zararlangan tomondan teskari og'ishi va qusish refleksi yo'qolishini beradi; qaytuvchi hiqildoq shoxi qalqonsimon bez jarrohligida xavf ostida; vagus stimulyatsiyasi epilepsiya va depressiyani davolaydi.

description.en: Its spinal root rises from the upper cervical cord through the foramen magnum, joins briefly with the cranial root and leaves through the jugular foramen to the neck.
description.uz: Orqa miya ildizi yuqori bo'yin segmentlaridan katta teshik orqali ko'tarilib, qisqa vaqt bosh ildizi bilan qo'shiladi va bo'yinturuq teshigi orqali bo'yinga chiqadi.

role.en: Motor supply to the sternocleidomastoid (turns the head to the opposite side) and trapezius (shrugs the shoulder).
role.uz: To'sh-o'mrov-so'rg'ichsimon mushak (boshni qarama-qarshi tomonga buradi) va trapetsiyasimon mushak (yelkani ko'taradi) harakati.

clinical.en: Commonly injured during lymph node biopsy in the posterior neck triangle → drooping shoulder and weak shrug.
clinical.uz: Bo'yinning orqa uchburchagida limfa tuguni biopsiyasida tez-tez jarohatlanadi → yelka osilishi va zaif yelka ko'tarish.

description.en: Leaves the medulla between the pyramid and the olive as several rootlets, exits through the hypoglossal canal and curves forward under the tongue.
description.uz: Uzunchoq miyadan piramida bilan zaytun orasidan bir nechta ildizcha bo'lib chiqadi, til osti kanali orqali o'tib til ostida oldinga egiladi.

role.en: Motor supply to all intrinsic and most extrinsic muscles of the tongue.
role.uz: Tilning barcha ichki va ko'pchilik tashqi mushaklari harakati.

clinical.en: A lesion makes the protruded tongue deviate toward the weak side, with wasting and fasciculation; at risk in carotid endarterectomy.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishida chiqarilgan til zaif tomonga og'adi, atrofiya va fastsikulyatsiya bilan; uyqu arteriyasi endarterektomiyasida xavf ostida.

description.en: The tough outer meningeal layer lining the skull, made of an outer periosteal and an inner meningeal layer that separate to enclose the venous sinuses. Its folds (falx, tentorium) partition the cranial cavity.
description.uz: Bosh suyagi ichini qoplovchi pishiq tashqi miya pardasi; tashqi periostal va ichki meningeal qatlamlari venoz sinuslarni o'rab olish uchun ajraladi. Burmalari (falx, tentorium) bosh suyagi bo'shlig'ini bo'limlarga ajratadi.

role.en: Protects and anchors the brain, carries the venous sinuses and is the only pain-sensitive covering of the brain (supplied by the trigeminal nerve).
role.uz: Miyani himoya qiladi va mahkamlaydi, venoz sinuslarni o'z ichiga oladi va miyaning yagona og'riq sezuvchi qobig'i (uch shoxli nerv innervatsiya qiladi).
