clinical.en: Epidural haematoma collects between dura and skull (middle meningeal artery); subdural haematoma between dura and arachnoid (bridging veins). Meningiomas arise from its arachnoid cap cells.
clinical.uz: Epidural gematoma parda bilan bosh suyagi orasida (o'rta meningeal arteriya), subdural gematoma parda bilan o'rgimchak to'r parda orasida (ko'prik venalari) to'planadi. Meningiomalar uning araxnoid hujayralaridan kelib chiqadi.

description.en: A sickle-shaped vertical fold of dura in the midline between the two cerebral hemispheres, from the crista galli to the tentorium. The superior sagittal sinus runs in its upper edge, the inferior sagittal sinus in its lower free edge.
description.uz: Ikki bosh miya yarim shari orasida, crista galli'dan tentoriumgacha o'rta chiziqda joylashgan o'roqsimon vertikal parda burmasi. Yuqori qirrasida yuqori sagittal sinus, pastki erkin qirrasida pastki sagittal sinus o'tadi.

role.en: Stabilises the hemispheres against rotational forces and houses the sagittal sinuses.
role.uz: Yarim sharlarni aylanma kuchlarga qarshi barqarorlashtiradi va sagittal sinuslarni o'z ichiga oladi.

clinical.en: Subfalcine herniation — the cingulate gyrus is pushed under its free edge by a mass, compressing the anterior cerebral artery.
clinical.uz: Subfalksin churra — o'sma yoki gematoma singulyat burmani uning erkin qirrasi ostiga itaradi, oldingi miya arteriyasi siqiladi.

description.en: A tent-like horizontal fold of dura separating the occipital lobes above from the cerebellum below. Its free anterior edge forms the tentorial notch around the midbrain; the transverse sinuses run in its attached edge.
description.uz: Yuqoridagi ensa bo'laklarini pastdagi miyachadan ajratuvchi chodirsimon gorizontal parda burmasi. Erkin oldingi qirrasi o'rta miya atrofida tentorial o'yiqni hosil qiladi; birikkan qirrasida ko'ndalang sinuslar o'tadi.

role.en: Supports the weight of the occipital lobes and divides the cranial cavity into supratentorial and infratentorial compartments.
role.uz: Ensa bo'laklarining og'irligini ko'taradi va bosh suyagi bo'shlig'ini supratentorial va infratentorial bo'limlarga ajratadi.

clinical.en: Uncal (transtentorial) herniation squeezes the uncus through the notch: dilated pupil (CN III), then contralateral hemiparesis and coma. Tentorial meningiomas are a classic neurosurgical challenge.
clinical.uz: Uncal (transtentorial) churra uncusni o'yiq orqali itaradi: kengaygan qorachiq (III nerv), keyin qarama-qarshi gemiparez va koma. Tentorial meningiomalar — klassik neyroxirurgik murakkab holat.

description.en: The bone of the forehead and the roof of the orbits, containing the frontal sinuses; it joins the parietal bones at the coronal suture.
description.uz: Peshona va ko'z kosalari tomining suyagi; peshona bo'shliqlarini o'z ichiga oladi, tepa suyaklari bilan tojsimon chok orqali birikadi.

role.en: Protects the frontal lobes and forms the anterior cranial fossa floor over the orbits.
role.uz: Peshona bo'laklarini himoya qiladi va ko'z kosalari ustida oldingi bosh suyagi chuqurchasi tubini hosil qiladi.

clinical.en: Frontal sinus fractures can tear the dura (CSF leak, infection); the bicoronal flap for anterior skull-base surgery is raised here.
clinical.uz: Peshona bo'shlig'i sinishlari qattiq pardani yirtishi mumkin (likvor oqishi, infeksiya); oldingi bosh suyagi asosi jarrohligida bikoronal lambar shu yerdan ko'tariladi.

description.en: The paired plate forming the sides and roof of the skull vault, between the frontal and occipital bones, meeting its partner at the sagittal suture.
description.uz: Bosh suyagi gumbazining yon va tom qismini hosil qiluvchi juft plastinka; peshona va ensa suyaklari orasida, jufti bilan sagittal chokda uchrashadi.

role.en: Protects the parietal lobes; the superior sagittal sinus runs beneath the sagittal suture.
role.uz: Tepa bo'laklarini himoya qiladi; sagittal chok ostida yuqori sagittal sinus o'tadi.

clinical.en: Burr holes and craniotomies are most often made here; the anterior fontanelle at its front corner closes at about 18 months.
clinical.uz: Trepanatsiya teshiklari va kraniotomiyalar ko'pincha shu yerda qilinadi; oldingi burchagidagi katta liqildoq ~18 oyda yopiladi.

description.en: The bone of the back and base of the skull, pierced by the foramen magnum through which the brainstem continues as the spinal cord; the occipital condyles articulate with the atlas.
description.uz: Bosh suyagining orqa va asos qismi; katta teshik orqali miya ustuni orqa miyaga davom etadi; ensa bo'rtiqlari atlant bilan bo'g'im hosil qiladi.

role.en: Houses the cerebellum and medulla in the posterior fossa and carries the head on the spine.
role.uz: Orqa chuqurchada miyacha va uzunchoq miyani joylashtiradi va boshni umurtqa pog'onasida tutadi.

clinical.en: Suboccipital craniotomy for posterior-fossa tumours; Chiari malformation herniates the cerebellar tonsils through the foramen magnum.
clinical.uz: Orqa chuqurcha o'smalari uchun subokssipital kraniotomiya; Chiari malformatsiyasida miyacha bodomchalari katta teshik orqali churra bo'ladi.

description.en: A complex bone of the side and base of the skull with squamous, petrous, tympanic and mastoid parts. The dense petrous part houses the inner ear and the carotid canal; the facial and vestibulocochlear nerves run through it.
description.uz: Bosh suyagining yon va asos qismidagi murakkab suyak; tangasimon, toshsimon, nog'ora va so'rg'ichsimon qismlari bor. Zich toshsimon qismi ichki quloq va uyqu arteriyasi kanalini o'z ichiga oladi; yuz va eshituv-vestibulyar nervlar undan o'tadi.

role.en: Protects the hearing and balance organs and forms the middle cranial fossa floor.
role.uz: Eshitish va muvozanat a'zolarini himoya qiladi va o'rta bosh suyagi chuqurchasi tubini hosil qiladi.

clinical.en: The thin squamous part over the middle meningeal artery is the classic site of epidural haematoma; petrous fractures cause hearing loss, facial palsy, CSF otorrhoea and Battle's sign.
clinical.uz: O'rta meningeal arteriya ustidagi yupqa tangasimon qismi epidural gematomaning klassik joyi; toshsimon qism sinishlari eshitish pasayishi, yuz falaji, likvor otoreyasi va Battle belgisini beradi.

description.en: The butterfly-shaped keystone of the skull base, with a central body (containing the sphenoid sinus and the sella turcica for the pituitary), greater and lesser wings and pterygoid processes. Many nerves and vessels pass through its foramina.
description.uz: Bosh suyagi asosining kapalaksimon tayanch suyagi; markaziy tana (ponasimon bo'shliq va gipofiz uchun turk egari), katta va kichik qanotlar hamda qanotsimon o'simtalar. Ko'plab nerv va tomirlar uning teshiklaridan o'tadi.

role.en: Links the facial skeleton to the cranial vault and carries the optic canal, superior orbital fissure and foramina rotundum, ovale and spinosum.
role.uz: Yuz skeletini bosh suyagi gumbazi bilan bog'laydi; ko'rish kanali, yuqori ko'z kosasi yorig'i va rotundum, ovale, spinosum teshiklarini o'z ichiga oladi.

clinical.en: Pituitary surgery goes through its sinus (trans-sphenoidal approach); sphenoid wing meningiomas compress the optic nerve.
clinical.uz: Gipofiz jarrohligi uning bo'shlig'i orqali o'tadi (transsfenoidal yo'l); ponasimon suyak qanoti meningiomalari ko'rish nervini siqadi.

description.en: A light, spongy bone between the orbits at the roof of the nose: the cribriform plate (pierced by olfactory nerves), the perpendicular plate (nasal septum) and the ethmoidal labyrinths (air cells).
description.uz: Ko'z kosalari orasida, burun tomidagi yengil, g'ovak suyak: teshikli plastinka (hidlov nervlari o'tadi), perpendikulyar plastinka (burun to'sig'i) va g'alvirsimon labirintlar (havo hujayralari).

role.en: Separates the nasal cavity from the anterior cranial fossa and lets the olfactory nerves through.
role.uz: Burun bo'shlig'ini oldingi bosh suyagi chuqurchasidan ajratadi va hidlov nervlarini o'tkazadi.

clinical.en: Cribriform plate fracture → anosmia and CSF rhinorrhoea (risk of meningitis); endoscopic sinus surgery must avoid breaching its roof.
clinical.uz: Teshikli plastinka sinishi → anosmiya va likvor rinoreyasi (meningit xavfi); endoskopik sinus jarrohligida uning tomini teshmaslik kerak.

description.en: The cheekbone, forming the prominence of the cheek, the lateral wall and floor of the orbit and, with the temporal bone, the zygomatic arch.
description.uz: Yonoq suyagi; yonoq bo'rtig'i, ko'z kosasining lateral devori va tubi hamda chakka suyagi bilan birga yonoq ravog'ini hosil qiladi.

role.en: Protects the eye and anchors the masseter muscle.
role.uz: Ko'zni himoya qiladi va chaynov mushagini mahkamlaydi.

clinical.en: Zygomatic (tripod) fractures flatten the cheek and can trap the eye muscles; the arch is removed temporarily in orbitozygomatic skull-base approaches.
clinical.uz: Yonoq (tripod) sinishlari yonoqni tekislaydi va ko'z mushaklarini qisib qo'yishi mumkin; orbitozigomatik bosh suyagi asosi yondashuvlarida ravoq vaqtincha olinadi.

description.en: The upper jaw, holding the upper teeth and forming the floor of the orbit, the floor and lateral wall of the nose and most of the hard palate; it contains the large maxillary sinus.
description.uz: Yuqori jag'; yuqori tishlarni tutadi, ko'z kosasi tubi, burun tubi va lateral devori hamda qattiq tanglayning ko'p qismini hosil qiladi; katta yuqori jag' bo'shlig'ini o'z ichiga oladi.

role.en: The central bone of the midface, transmitting chewing forces to the skull base.
role.uz: Yuz o'rta qismining markaziy suyagi; chaynov kuchlarini bosh suyagi asosiga uzatadi.

clinical.en: Le Fort fractures separate the midface at different levels; the infraorbital nerve runs through it and is numbed by orbital floor fractures.
clinical.uz: Le Fort sinishlari yuz o'rta qismini turli darajalarda ajratadi; ko'z kosasi osti nervi undan o'tadi va ko'z kosasi tubi sinishlarida uvishadi.

description.en: The lower jaw, the largest and strongest facial bone: a horizontal body carrying the lower teeth and two rami that articulate with the temporal bone at the temporomandibular joints.
description.uz: Pastki jag', eng katta va mustahkam yuz suyagi: pastki tishlarni tutuvchi gorizontal tana va chakka suyagi bilan chakka-pastki jag' bo'g'imlarida birikuvchi ikki shox.

role.en: Chewing and speech; the inferior alveolar nerve runs through its canal.
role.uz: Chaynash va nutq; pastki alveolyar nerv uning kanali orqali o'tadi.

clinical.en: The most commonly fractured facial bone after the nose, often in two places; TMJ dysfunction is a frequent cause of facial pain.
clinical.uz: Burundan keyin eng ko'p sinadigan yuz suyagi, ko'pincha ikki joydan; chakka-pastki jag' bo'g'imi disfunksiyasi yuz og'rig'ining tez-tez uchraydigan sababi.

description.en: Two small oblong bones forming the bridge of the nose.
description.uz: Burun qirrasini hosil qiluvchi ikki kichik cho'zinchoq suyak.

role.en: Support the upper nose.
role.uz: Burunning yuqori qismini tutib turadi.

clinical.en: The most commonly fractured bone of the face.
clinical.uz: Yuzning eng ko'p sinadigan suyagi.

description.en: The smallest bone of the face, a thin plate in the medial orbital wall grooved for the lacrimal sac.
description.uz: Yuzning eng kichik suyagi; ko'z kosasi medial devoridagi, ko'z yosh xaltasi uchun egatli yupqa plastinka.

role.en: Houses the lacrimal sac at the start of the tear drainage pathway.
role.uz: Ko'z yosh oqish yo'li boshidagi ko'z yosh xaltasini joylashtiradi.

clinical.en: Opened in dacryocystorhinostomy for a blocked tear duct.
clinical.uz: Ko'z yosh yo'li tiqilganda dakriotsistorinostomiyada ochiladi.

description.en: An L-shaped bone forming the back of the hard palate and part of the nasal cavity wall and orbital floor.
description.uz: Qattiq tanglayning orqa qismi hamda burun bo'shlig'i devori va ko'z kosasi tubining bir qismini hosil qiluvchi L-shaklidagi suyak.

role.en: Separates the mouth from the nose posteriorly; the greater palatine nerve and vessels pass through its foramen.
role.uz: Og'izni burundan orqada ajratadi; katta tanglay nervi va tomirlari uning teshigi orqali o'tadi.

clinical.en: Involved in cleft palate; the greater palatine foramen is a site for palatal anaesthesia.
clinical.uz: Tanglay yorig'ida ishtirok etadi; katta tanglay teshigi tanglay anesteziyasi joyi.

description.en: A thin flat bone forming the lower back part of the nasal septum.
description.uz: Burun to'sig'ining pastki orqa qismini hosil qiluvchi yupqa yassi suyak.

role.en: Divides the nasal cavity into two.
role.uz: Burun bo'shlig'ini ikkiga bo'ladi.

clinical.en: Deviation contributes to nasal obstruction (septoplasty).
clinical.uz: Qiyshayishi burun tiqilishiga hissa qo'shadi (septoplastika).

description.en: A separate scroll-shaped bone on the lateral nasal wall below the middle concha, covered by thick vascular mucosa.
description.uz: Burun lateral devorida, o'rta chig'anoq ostidagi alohida o'ramsimon suyak; qalin tomirli shilliq parda bilan qoplangan.

role.en: Warms, humidifies and filters inhaled air; the nasolacrimal duct opens beneath it.
role.uz: Nafas olinadigan havoni isitadi, namlaydi va filtrlaydi; burun-ko'z yosh yo'li uning ostiga ochiladi.

clinical.en: Hypertrophy causes nasal obstruction (turbinate reduction surgery).
clinical.uz: Gipertrofiyasi burun tiqilishiga olib keladi (chig'anoqni kichraytirish jarrohligi).

description.en: The medial parietal gyrus between the marginal branch of the cingulate sulcus in front and the parieto-occipital sulcus behind, above the isthmus of the cingulate — hidden in the interhemispheric fissure.
description.uz: Old tomondan belbog' egatining marginal shoxi, orqadan parieto-oksipital egat bilan chegaralangan, belbog' pushtasi bo'yni ustidagi medial parietal pushta — yarim sharlararo yoriqda yashiringan.

role.en: A hub of the default-mode network: episodic memory retrieval, visuospatial imagery, self-referential thought and consciousness; one of the most metabolically active cortical regions at rest.
role.uz: Sukut rejimi tarmog'ining markazi: epizodik xotirani eslash, ko'rish-fazoviy tasavvur, o'ziga qaratilgan fikrlash va hush; tinch holatda metabolik eng faol po'stloq sohalaridan biri.

clinical.en: Hypometabolism in early Alzheimer's disease (posterior cingulate/precuneus on FDG-PET); deactivation in anaesthesia and vegetative state; falx meningiomas and ACA infarcts involve it.
clinical.uz: Erta Alzheimer kasalligida gipometabolizm (FDG-PET'da orqa belbog'/precuneus); anesteziya va vegetativ holatda faolsizlanish; falx meningiomalari va ACA infarktlari uni qamrab oladi.

description.en: The wedge-shaped medial occipital gyrus between the calcarine sulcus below and the parieto-occipital sulcus above; its lower bank holds the upper half of the primary visual cortex (V1).
description.uz: Pastdan calcarine egat, yuqoridan parieto-oksipital egat bilan chegaralangan ponasimon medial ensa pushtasi; pastki qirg'og'ida birlamchi ko'rish po'stlog'ining (V1) yuqori yarmi joylashgan.

role.en: Represents the contralateral lower visual field (the calcarine cortex above the sulcus) and extrastriate areas V2/V3 involved in early visual processing.
role.uz: Qarama-qarshi tomonning pastki ko'rish maydonini (egat ustidagi calcarine po'stloq) va erta ko'rish qayta ishlovidagi ekstrastriar V2/V3 sohalarni ifodalaydi.

clinical.en: A cuneus lesion (PCA infarct) produces a contralateral inferior quadrantanopia with macular sparing.
clinical.uz: Cuneus zararlanishi (PCA infarkti) makula saqlangan holda qarama-qarshi pastki kvadrant anopsiyasini beradi.

description.en: The parietal convexity above the intraparietal sulcus, behind the postcentral sulcus and in front of the parieto-occipital sulcus — Brodmann areas 5 and 7, continuous medially with the precuneus.
description.uz: Intraparietal egat ustida, orqa markaziy egat orqasida va parieto-oksipital egat oldidagi parietal qavariq — Brodmann 5 va 7 maydonlari; medial tomonda precuneus bilan tutash.

role.en: Dorsal-stream integration of vision and proprioception for reaching, grasping and spatial attention; area 5 processes somatosensory input for limb position, area 7 visuomotor coordination.
role.uz: Uzatish, ushlash va fazoviy diqqat uchun ko'rish va proprioretsepsiyani dorsal oqimda birlashtirish; 5-maydon oyoq-qo'l holati uchun somatosensor signalni, 7-maydon ko'rish-harakat muvofiqligini qayta ishlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause optic ataxia (misreaching under visual guidance) and, with the angular gyrus, Bálint syndrome and contralateral hemispatial neglect (usually right-sided lesions).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi optik ataksiya (ko'rish nazoratida noto'g'ri uzatish) va, burchak pushtasi bilan birga, Bálint sindromi hamda qarama-qarshi fazoviy e'tiborsizlik (odatda o'ng tomon zararlanishida) beradi.

description.en: The midline septal region: the thin two-layered septum pellucidum stretched between corpus callosum and fornix (separating the frontal horns), and below it the septal nuclei (medial, lateral, nucleus of the diagonal band) in the paraterminal gyrus.
description.uz: O'rta chiziqdagi septal soha: qadoqsimon tana bilan gumbaz orasiga tortilgan yupqa ikki qavatli shaffof to'siq (old shoxlarni ajratadi) va uning ostida paraterminal pushtadagi septal yadrolar (medial, lateral, diagonal tutam yadrosi).

role.en: The septal nuclei are a limbic relay between hippocampus (via the fornix) and hypothalamus/habenula; the medial septum drives hippocampal theta rhythm and supplies cholinergic input to the hippocampus.
role.uz: Septal yadrolar gippokamp (gumbaz orqali) bilan gipotalamus/habenula orasidagi limbik uzatgich; medial septum gippokamp teta ritmini boshqaradi va gippokampga xolinergik signal beradi.

clinical.en: Cavum septi pellucidi (persistent cavity) is a normal variant but is frequent in boxers/chronic traumatic encephalopathy; septal lesions cause 'septal rage' and memory impairment; absent septum in septo-optic dysplasia.
clinical.uz: Cavum septi pellucidi (saqlanib qolgan bo'shliq) me'yoriy variant, lekin bokschilar/surunkali travmatik ensefalopatiyada tez uchraydi; septal zararlanish 'septal g'azab' va xotira buzilishini beradi; septo-optik displaziyada to'siq yo'q.

description.en: The thin triangular sheet of crossing fibres between the two crura of the fornix beneath the splenium of the corpus callosum — the hippocampal commissure or 'lyre' (psalterium).
description.uz: Qadoqsimon tana splenium'i ostida gumbazning ikki oyoqchasi orasidagi kesishuvchi tolalarning yupqa uchburchak qatlami — gippokamp komissurasi yoki 'lira' (psalterium).

role.en: Connects the two hippocampal formations, allowing interhemispheric transfer of memory-related activity.
role.uz: Ikki gippokamp tuzilmasini bog'lab, xotira bilan bog'liq faollikning yarim sharlararo o'tishini ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: A route of interhemispheric seizure spread in temporal-lobe epilepsy; surgical landmark in transcallosal approaches to the third ventricle.
clinical.uz: Chakka bo'lagi epilepsiyasida tutqanoqning yarim sharlararo tarqalish yo'li; III qorinchaga transkallozal yondashuvda jarrohlik orientiri.

description.en: The white-matter core of the temporal lobe: the temporal stem (uncinate and inferior fronto-occipital fasciculi, anterior commissure fibres, Meyer's loop of the optic radiation), the arcuate/superior longitudinal fasciculus in the posterior part and the inferior longitudinal fasciculus along its length.
description.uz: Chakka bo'lagining oq modda o'zagi: chakka poyasi (uncinate va pastki fronto-oksipital tutamlar, old komissura tolalari, ko'rish radiatsiyasining Meyer halqasi), orqa qismida yoysimon/yuqori bo'ylama tutam va butun uzunligi bo'ylab pastki bo'ylama tutam.

role.en: Carries language (arcuate), semantic (IFOF, ILF), limbic (uncinate) and visual (optic radiation) pathways through the temporal lobe.
role.uz: Chakka bo'lagi orqali til (yoysimon), semantik (IFOF, ILF), limbik (uncinate) va ko'rish (ko'rish radiatsiyasi) yo'llarini o'tkazadi.

clinical.en: Temporal-lobe resection for epilepsy must respect Meyer's loop (superior quadrantanopia risk) and the arcuate fasciculus on the dominant side.
clinical.uz: Epilepsiyada chakka bo'lagi rezeksiyasida Meyer halqasi (yuqori kvadrant anopsiya xavfi) va dominant tomonda yoysimon tutamni saqlash zarur.

description.en: The white-matter core of the temporal lobe: the temporal stem (uncinate and inferior fronto-occipital fasciculi, anterior commissure fibres, Meyer's loop of the optic radiation), the arcuate/superior longitudinal fasciculus in the posterior part and the inferior longitudinal fasciculus along its length.
description.uz: Chakka bo'lagining oq modda o'zagi: chakka poyasi (uncinate va pastki fronto-oksipital tutamlar, old komissura tolalari, ko'rish radiatsiyasining Meyer halqasi), orqa qismida yoysimon/yuqori bo'ylama tutam va butun uzunligi bo'ylab pastki bo'ylama tutam.

role.en: Carries language (arcuate), semantic (IFOF, ILF), limbic (uncinate) and visual (optic radiation) pathways through the temporal lobe.
role.uz: Chakka bo'lagi orqali til (yoysimon), semantik (IFOF, ILF), limbik (uncinate) va ko'rish (ko'rish radiatsiyasi) yo'llarini o'tkazadi.

clinical.en: Temporal-lobe resection for epilepsy must respect Meyer's loop (superior quadrantanopia risk) and the arcuate fasciculus on the dominant side.
clinical.uz: Epilepsiyada chakka bo'lagi rezeksiyasida Meyer halqasi (yuqori kvadrant anopsiya xavfi) va dominant tomonda yoysimon tutamni saqlash zarur.

description.en: The ventral fibre mass of the cerebral peduncle on each side of the interpeduncular fossa, carrying corticospinal, corticobulbar and corticopontine fibres from the internal capsule to the pons; the oculomotor nerve emerges on its medial side.
description.uz: Oyoqchalararo chuqurchaning har ikki yonidagi miya oyoqchasining ventral tola massasi; ichki kapsuladan ko'prikka kortikospinal, kortikobulbar va kortikopontin tolalarni olib boradi. III nerv uning medial tomonidan chiqadi.

role.en: The descending motor highway from cortex to brainstem and spinal cord, somatotopically ordered face-arm-leg from medial to lateral.
role.uz: Po'stloqdan miya ustuni va orqa miyaga tushuvchi harakat 'shohko'chasi'; medialdan lateralga yuz-qo'l-oyoq tartibida somatotopik.

clinical.en: Weber syndrome (PCA perforator infarct): ipsilateral CN III palsy + contralateral hemiplegia. Kernohan's notch phenomenon in uncal herniation. Anterior-choroidal and P1 perforators supply it.
clinical.uz: Weber sindromi (PCA perforant infarkti): o'sha tomonda III nerv falaji + qarama-qarshi gemiplegiya. Unkal churrada Kernohan o'yig'i hodisasi. Old xorioidal va P1 perforantlari qon bilan ta'minlaydi.

description.en: A slender fibre bundle running along the dorsomedial edge of the thalamus at the attachment of the roof of the third ventricle, from the septal region and preoptic hypothalamus back to the habenula.
description.uz: III qorincha tomi birikkan joyda talamusning dorsomedial cheti bo'ylab, septal soha va preoptik gipotalamusdan orqaga habenulagacha cho'zilgan ingichka tola tutami.

role.en: Afferent limb of the dorsal diencephalic conduction system: carries limbic and basal-forebrain input to the habenula, which then inhibits midbrain dopamine and serotonin neurons via the fasciculus retroflexus.
role.uz: Dorsal diensefal o'tkazuvchi tizimning afferent qismi: limbik va bazal old miya signallarini habenulaga olib boradi; habenula esa fasciculus retroflexus orqali o'rta miya dofamin va serotonin neyronlarini tormozlaydi.

clinical.en: Part of the 'anti-reward' circuit implicated in depression; the habenula/stria medullaris is an experimental DBS target for treatment-resistant depression. A landmark in endoscopic third-ventricle surgery.
clinical.uz: Depressiyada ishtirok etuvchi 'anti-mukofot' halqasining qismi; habenula/stria medullaris — davoga chidamli depressiyada eksperimental DBS nishoni. Endoskopik III qorincha jarrohligida orientir.

description.en: The grey eminence on the floor of the third ventricle between the optic chiasm and the mammillary bodies, from which the infundibulum (pituitary stalk) descends; it contains the arcuate and ventromedial nuclei and the median eminence.
description.uz: III qorincha tubida ko'rish kesishmasi bilan so'rg'ichsimon tanalar orasidagi kulrang bo'rtma; undan infundibulum (gipofiz oyoqchasi) pastga tushadi. Yoysimon va ventromedial yadrolar hamda median bo'rtmani o'z ichiga oladi.

role.en: The hypophysiotropic zone: releasing and inhibiting hormones from arcuate/periventricular neurons enter the hypophyseal portal capillaries of the median eminence here.
role.uz: Gipofiziotrop zona: yoysimon/periventrikulyar neyronlarning rilizing va ingibitor gormonlari shu yerda median bo'rtmaning gipofizar portal kapillyarlariga kiradi.

clinical.en: Hypothalamic hamartoma of the tuber cinereum causes gelastic seizures and central precocious puberty (treated by laser ablation or endoscopic disconnection). Endoscopic third ventriculostomy is performed just in front of the mammillary bodies through its floor.
clinical.uz: Tuber cinereum gipotalamik gamartomasi gelastik tutqanoqlar va markaziy erta jinsiy yetilish beradi (lazer ablatsiyasi yoki endoskopik ajratish bilan davolanadi). Endoskopik III qorincha ventrikulostomiyasi so'rg'ichsimon tanalar oldidan uning tubi orqali bajariladi.

description.en: A diffuse cell group of the preoptic area lateral to the medial preoptic nucleus, traversed by the medial forebrain bundle, above the optic chiasm at the front of the hypothalamus.
description.uz: Preoptik sohaning medial preoptik yadrodan lateraldagi, medial old miya tutami kesib o'tadigan tarqoq hujayralar guruhi; gipotalamus oldida, ko'rish kesishmasi ustida.

role.en: Contains GABAergic sleep-active neurons (with the ventrolateral preoptic nucleus) that inhibit the arousal system, and neurons involved in thirst and osmoregulation.
role.uz: Uyg'oqlik tizimini tormozlovchi GABAergik uyqu-faol neyronlarni (ventrolateral preoptik yadro bilan birga) hamda chanqoq va osmoregulyatsiyada ishtirok etuvchi neyronlarni o'z ichiga oladi.

clinical.en: Preoptic lesions (von Economo's encephalitis, anterior hypothalamic stroke) cause insomnia; the region degenerates in Alzheimer's disease, contributing to sleep fragmentation.
clinical.uz: Preoptik zararlanish (von Economo ensefaliti, old gipotalamus insulti) uyqusizlik beradi; Alzheimer kasalligida bu soha degeneratsiyaga uchrab, uyqu bo'linishiga hissa qo'shadi.

description.en: The principal nucleus of the preoptic area, beside the third ventricle just above the optic chiasm; contains the sexually dimorphic nucleus (INAH-3) and GnRH-related circuitry.
description.uz: Preoptik sohaning asosiy yadrosi; III qorincha yonida, ko'rish kesishmasidan sal yuqorida. Jinsiy dimorf yadro (INAH-3) va GnRH bilan bog'liq zanjirlarni o'z ichiga oladi.

role.en: Thermoregulation (warm-sensitive neurons that trigger sweating, vasodilation and fever responses), sexual and parental behaviour, and control of gonadotropin release.
role.uz: Termoregulyatsiya (terlash, tomir kengayishi va isitma javoblarini boshlovchi issiqqa sezgir neyronlar), jinsiy va ota-onalik xulqi hamda gonadotropin ajralishini boshqarish.

clinical.en: Prostaglandin E2 acting on preoptic neurons produces fever; lesions cause hyperthermia and loss of thermoregulation (e.g., after anterior hypothalamic injury or craniopharyngioma surgery).
clinical.uz: Prostaglandin E2 preoptik neyronlarga ta'sir qilib isitma beradi; zararlanishi gipertermiya va termoregulyatsiya yo'qolishini keltiradi (masalan, old gipotalamus jarohati yoki kraniofaringioma jarrohligidan keyin).

description.en: A tiny paired nucleus of ~20 000 neurons sitting directly on the optic chiasm on either side of the third ventricle, receiving the retinohypothalamic tract from intrinsically photosensitive retinal ganglion cells.
description.uz: III qorinchaning har ikki yonida bevosita ko'rish kesishmasi ustida o'tirgan ~20 000 neyronli mitti juft yadro; o'ziga xos yorug'likka sezgir to'r parda ganglioz hujayralaridan retinogipotalamik traktni oladi.

role.en: The master circadian clock: entrains the ~24-hour rhythms of sleep-wake, body temperature, cortisol and melatonin (via the paraventricular nucleus → sympathetic → pineal pathway) to the light-dark cycle.
role.uz: Bosh sirkad soati: uyqu-uyg'oqlik, tana harorati, kortizol va melatonin (paraventrikulyar yadro → simpatik → epifiz yo'li orqali) ~24 soatlik ritmlarini yorug'lik-qorong'ilik sikliga moslaydi.

clinical.en: Damage (suprasellar tumours, craniopharyngioma surgery) abolishes circadian rhythmicity; SCN degeneration underlies the sleep disturbance and 'sundowning' of Alzheimer's disease; jet lag and shift-work disorder are SCN desynchronisation.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi (suprasellyar o'smalar, kraniofaringioma jarrohligi) sirkad ritmni yo'qotadi; SCN degeneratsiyasi Alzheimer kasalligidagi uyqu buzilishi va kechki bezovtalik ('sundowning') asosida yotadi; jet lag va smenali ish buzilishi — SCN desinxronizatsiyasi.

description.en: A dense cluster of large magnocellular neurons straddling the lateral edge of the optic chiasm/tract in the anterior hypothalamus, whose axons run in the supraoptico-hypophyseal tract to the posterior pituitary.
description.uz: Old gipotalamusda ko'rish kesishmasi/trakti lateral chetini egarlab olgan yirik magnotsellyulyar neyronlarning zich to'plami; aksonlari supraoptiko-gipofizar trakt orqali orqa gipofizga boradi.

role.en: Main source of vasopressin (ADH), and some oxytocin, released from the neurohypophysis in response to plasma osmolality and blood volume.
role.uz: Plazma osmolyalligi va qon hajmiga javoban neyrogipofizdan ajraladigan vazopressin (ADH) va qisman oksitotsinning asosiy manbai.

clinical.en: Destruction of the nucleus or high stalk section → permanent central diabetes insipidus (transient after transsphenoidal surgery — the 'triphasic response'); inappropriate ADH release (SIADH) after head injury and SAH.
clinical.uz: Yadro yoki oyoqchaning yuqori kesilishi → doimiy markaziy qandsiz diabet (transsfenoidal jarrohlikdan keyin vaqtinchalik — 'uch fazali javob'); bosh jarohati va SAH'dan keyin noo'rin ADH ajralishi (SIADH).

description.en: A thin sheet of small parvocellular neurons lining the wall of the third ventricle throughout the hypothalamus, medial to the paraventricular and arcuate nuclei.
description.uz: Butun gipotalamus bo'ylab III qorincha devorini qoplab turuvchi mayda parvotsellyulyar neyronlarning yupqa qatlami; paraventrikulyar va yoysimon yadrolardan medialda.

role.en: Hypophysiotropic neurons — chiefly somatostatin (inhibiting growth hormone) and dopamine (inhibiting prolactin) — projecting to the median eminence; part of the periventricular pain/stress-modulating grey continuous with the PAG.
role.uz: Median bo'rtmaga proyeksiya beruvchi gipofiziotrop neyronlar — asosan somatostatin (o'sish gormonini tormozlash) va dofamin (prolaktinni tormozlash); PAG bilan tutash periventrikulyar og'riq/stress modulyatsiya qiluvchi kulrang moddaning qismi.

clinical.en: Loss of dopaminergic inhibition (stalk compression by a suprasellar mass) causes hyperprolactinaemia; periventricular grey stimulation (PVG-DBS) is used for chronic pain.
clinical.uz: Dofaminergik tormozlanish yo'qolishi (suprasellyar massa oyoqchani bosganda) giperprolaktinemiya beradi; periventrikulyar kulrang modda stimulyatsiyasi (PVG-DBS) surunkali og'riqda qo'llanadi.
